name: Happiny
pokedex: It carries a round white rock in its belly pouch. If it gets along well with someone, it will sometimes give that person the rock.

name: Cleffa
pokedex: On nights with many shooting stars, Cleffa can be seen dancing in a ring. They dance until daybreak, when they quench their thirst with the morning dew.

name: Togepi
pokedex: As its energy, it uses the feelings of compassion and pleasure exuded by people and Pokémon. It stores up happy feelings in its shell, then shares them out.

name: Bounsweet
pokedex: A delectable aroma pours from its body.  Bounsweet's sweat can be watered down into a juice with just the right amount of sweetness.

name: Smoliv
pokedex: This Pokémon converts nutrients into oil, which it stores in the fruit on its head. It can easily go a whole week without eating or drinking.

name: Igglybuff
pokedex: Its soft and pliable body is very bouncy. When it sings continuously with all its might, its body steadily turns a deepening pink color.

name: Flabébé
pokedex: This Flabébé rides a red flower. Immediately after birth, this Pokémon begins flying around in search of a flower it likes.

name: Hatenna
pokedex: Via the protrusion on its head, it senses other creatures' emotions. If you don't have a calm disposition, it will never warm up to you.

name: Lotad
pokedex: This Pokémon lives in ponds with clean water. It is known to ferry small Pokémon across ponds by carrying them on the broad leaf on its head.

name: Azurill
pokedex: Its tail, which is packed with nutrition, is very bouncy like a rubber ball. On sunny days they gather at the edge of water and splash about for fun.

name: Lillipup
pokedex: It faces strong opponents with great courage. Because it doesn't yelp, it's extremely popular with Trainers who live in apartment buildings.

name: Hoppip
pokedex: This Pokémon drifts and floats with the wind. If it senses the approach of strong winds, a Hoppip links leaves with others to prepare against being blown away.

name: Wurmple
pokedex: It sticks to tree branches and eats leaves. The thread it spits from its mouth, which becomes gooey when it touches air, slows the movement of its foes.

name: Scatterbug
pokedex: When under attack from bird Pokémon, it spews a poisonous black powder that causes paralysis on contact. Scatterbug can live in any region or climate.

name: Pikipek
pokedex: This Pokémon feeds on berries, whose leftover seeds become the ammunition for the attacks it fires off from its mouth. It uses holes in trees for nesting.

name: Pidove
pokedex: This very forgetful Pokémon will wait for a new order from its Trainer even though it already has one. Flocks often gather in parks and plazas.

name: Pidgey
pokedex: It has an extremely sharp sense of direction. It can unerringly return home to its nest, however far it may be removed from its familiar surroundings.

name: Starly
pokedex: They flock around mountains and fields, chasing after bug Pokémon. However, they bicker if the group grows too big. Their singing is noisy and annoying.

name: Impidimp
pokedex: Through its nose, it sucks in the emanations produced by people and Pokémon when they feel annoyed. It thrives off this negative energy.

name: Seedot
pokedex: It hangs off branches and absorbs nutrients. When it finishes eating, its body becomes so heavy that it drops to the ground with a thump.

name: Sewaddle
pokedex: It chews up leaves and sews them with sticky thread extruded from its mouth. Since this Pokémon makes its own clothes, it is a mascot for fashion designers.

name: Slakoth
pokedex: It sleeps virtually all day and night long. It doesn't change its nest its entire life, but it sometimes travels great distances by swimming in rivers.

name: Ralts
pokedex: A Ralts has the power to sense the emotions of people and Pokémon with the horns on its head. It takes cover if it senses any hostility.

name: Budew
pokedex: Over the winter, it closes its bud and endures the cold. Sensitive to changing temperature, the bud is said to bloom when it feels the sun's warm touch.

name: Spheal
pokedex: It is completely covered with plushy fur. As a result, it never feels the cold even when it is rolling about on ice floes or diving in the sea.

name: Mareep
pokedex: Its fluffy wool rubs together and builds a static charge. The more energy is charged, the more brightly the lightbulb at the tip of its tail glows.

name: Grubbin
pokedex: They often gather near places frequented by electric Pokémon in order to avoid being attacked by bird Pokémon, though it normally lives underground.

name: Weedle
pokedex: A Weedle has an extremely acute sense of smell. It distinguishes its favorite kinds of leaves from those it dislikes by sniffing with its big red nose.

name: Pawmi
pokedex: The pads of its paws are electricity- discharging organs. Pawmi fires electricity from its forepaws while standing unsteadily on its hind legs.

name: Oddish
pokedex: This Pokémon grows by absorbing moonlight. During the daytime, it buries itself in the ground, leaving only its leaves exposed to avoid detection by its enemies.

name: Blipbug
pokedex: A constant collector of information, this Pokémon is very smart. Very strong is what it isn't.

name: Tinkatink
pokedex: This Pokémon pounds iron scraps together to make a hammer. It will remake the hammer again and again until it's satisfied with the result.

name: Swinub
pokedex: It roots for food by rubbing its snout against the ground. Its favorite food is a mushroom that grows under dried grass. It occasionally roots out hot springs.

name: Tympole
pokedex: By vibrating its cheeks, it emits sound waves imperceptible to humans. It uses the rhythm of these sounds to talk and warns others of danger.

name: Zigzagoon
pokedex: Its restlessness has it constantly moving in zigzags. It will purposely run into other Pokémon to start fights. It's thought to be the oldest form of Zigzagoon.

name: Pichu
pokedex: It is still inept at retaining electricity. When it is startled, it discharges power accidentally. It gets better at holding power as it grows older.

name: Zubat
pokedex: While living in pitch-black caverns, their eyes gradually grew shut and deprived them of vision. They use ultrasonic waves to detect obstacles.

name: Sprigatito
pokedex: The sweet scent its body gives off mesmerizes those around it. The scent grows stronger when this Pokémon is in the sun.

name: Tepig
pokedex: It loves to eat roasted berries, but sometimes it gets too excited and burns them to a crisp. It blows fire through its nose.

name: Whismur
pokedex: Its cries equal a jet plane in volume. It inhales through its ear canals. Because of this system, it can cry continually without having to catch its breath.

name: Chikorita
pokedex: It waves its leaf around to keep foes at bay. However, a sweet fragrance also wafts from the leaf, creating a friendly atmosphere that becalms the battlers.

name: Snivy
pokedex: It is very intelligent and calm. Being exposed to lots of sunlight makes its movements swifter. When they are not feeling well, their tails droop.

name: Chespin
pokedex: The quills on its head are usually soft. When it flexes them, the points become so hard and sharp that they can pierce rock without any effort.

name: Teddiursa
pokedex: It licks its palms that are sweetened by being soaked in honey. A Teddiursa makes its own honey by blending fruits and pollen collected by Beedrill.

name: Rolycoly
pokedex: Most of its body has the same composition as coal. Fittingly, this Pokémon was first discovered in coal mines about 400 years ago.

name: Popplio
pokedex: This Pokémon snorts body fluids from its nose, blowing balloons to smash into its foes. It practices diligently so it can learn to make big bubbles.

name: Rookidee
pokedex: It will bravely challenge any opponent, no matter how powerful. This Pokémon benefits from every battle--even a defeat increases its strength a bit.

name: Grookey
pokedex: When it uses its special stick to strike up a beat, the sound waves produced carry revitalizing energy to the plants and flowers in the area.

name: Chimchar
pokedex: Its fiery rear end is fueled by gas made in its belly. Before going to sleep, Chimchar extinguish the flame on their tails to prevent fires.

name: Caterpie
pokedex: Its voracious appetite compels it to devour leaves bigger than itself without hesitation. It releases a terribly strong odor from its antennae.

name: Poliwag
pokedex: It is possible to see this Pokémon's spiral innards right through its thin skin. However, the skin is also very flexible. Even sharp fangs bounce right off it.

name: Shinx
pokedex: It rapidly contracts and relaxes its muscles to generate electricity. Its body shines if endangered. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.

name: Mantyke
pokedex: When it swims close to the surface of the ocean, people aboard ships are able to observe the pattern on its back. It often swims in a school of Remoraid.

name: Vanillite
pokedex: The temperature of their breath is -58ºF. They create snow crystals and make snow fall in the areas around them. Vanillite is treasured by households in warm regions.

name: Sobble
pokedex: When scared, this Pokémon cries. Its tears pack the chemical punch of 100 onions, and attackers won't be able to resist weeping.

name: Nacli
pokedex: The ground scrapes its body as it travels, causing it to leave salt behind. Salt is constantly being created and replenished inside Nacli's body.

name: Bellsprout
pokedex: A Bellsprout's thin and flexible body lets it bend and sway to avoid any attack, however strong it may be. From its mouth, it leaks a fluid that melts even iron.

name: Froakie
pokedex: It protects its skin by covering its body in bubbles it secretes from its chest and back. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air, it keeps a watchful eye on its surroundings.

name: Rowlet
pokedex: This wary Pokémon uses photosynthesis to store up energy during the day, while becoming active at night. Silently it glides, drawing near to its target.

name: Mime Jr.
line: Mime Jr. > Mr. Mime/Mr. Mime > Mr. Rime
pokedex: In an attempt to confuse its enemy, it mimics the enemy's movements. Once mimicked, the foe cannot take its eyes off this Pokémon.

name: Trapinch
pokedex: Its big jaws crunch through boulders. Because its head is so big, it has a hard time getting back upright if it tips over onto its back.

name: Applin
pokedex: It spends its entire life inside an apple. It hides from its natural enemies, bird Pokémon, by pretending it's just an apple and nothing more.

name: Solosis
pokedex: Because their bodies are enveloped in a special liquid, they are fine in any environment, no matter how severe. They can use telepathy to talk with others.

name: Roggenrola
pokedex: The hexagonal cavity is its ear. It walks in the direction of sounds it hears, but if the sounds cease, it panics and topples over.

name: Fuecoco
pokedex: Its flame sac is small, so energy is always leaking out. This energy is released from the dent atop Fuecoco's head and flickers to and fro.

name: Timburr
pokedex: These Pokémon appear at building sites and help out with construction. They always carry squared logs. As they grow, they carry bigger logs.

name: Scorbunny
pokedex: A warm-up of running around gets fire energy coursing through this Pokémon's body. Once that happens, it's ready to fight at full power.

name: Abra
pokedex: A Pokémon that sleeps 18 hours a day. Observation revealed that it uses Teleport to change its location once every hour.

name: Turtwig
pokedex: The shell on its back is made of soil.  On a very healthy Turtwig, the shell  should feel moist. The leaf on its head wilts if it is thirsty.

name: Gothita
pokedex: They intently observe both Trainers and Pokémon. Apparently, Gothita are looking at something that only they can see. Their ribbonlike feelers increase their power.

name: Tynamo
pokedex: These Pokémon move in schools. One alone can emit only a trickle of electricity, so a group of them gathers to unleash a powerful electric shock.

name: Geodude
pokedex: Its body is a magnetic stone. Iron sand attach to parts of its body with stronger magnetism. If you carelessly step on one, it will headbutt and shock you in anger.

name: Magnemite
pokedex: The units at its sides are extremely powerful magnets. They generate enough magnetism to draw in iron objects from over 300 feet away.

name: Oshawott
pokedex: The scalchop on its stomach isn't just used for battle, it can be used to break open hard berries as well. It is made from the same element as its claws.

name: Torchic
pokedex: If attacked, it strikes back by spitting balls of fire it forms in its stomach. A Torchic dislikes darkness because it can't see its surroundings.

name: Piplup
pokedex: A poor walker, it often falls down. However, its strong pride makes it puff up its chest without a care. It's difficult to bond with since it won't listen to its Trainer.

name: Quaxly
pokedex: Its strong legs let it easily swim around in even fast-flowing rivers. It likes to keep things tidy and is prone to overthinking things.

name: Mudkip
pokedex: On land, it can powerfully lift large boulders by planting its four feet and heaving. It sleeps by burying itself in soil at the water's edge.

name: Geodude
pokedex: It climbs mountain paths using only the power of its arms. Because they look just like boulders lining paths, hikers may step on them without noticing.

name: Litwick
pokedex: While Litwick shines a light and pretends to be a guide, it absorbs the life force of any who follow it, which becomes the fuel that it burns.

name: Bulbasaur
pokedex: Bulbasaur can be seen napping in bright sunlight. There is a seed on its back. By soaking up the sun's rays, the seed grows progressively larger.

name: Squirtle
pokedex: Its shell is not just for protection. Its rounded shape and the grooves on its surface minimize resistance in water, enabling Squirtle to swim at high speeds.

name: Horsea
pokedex: By cleverly flicking the fins on its back side to side, it moves in any direction while facing forward. It spits ink to escape if it senses danger.

name: Elekid
pokedex: If it touches metal and discharges the electricity it has stored in its body, an Elekid begins swinging its arms in circles to recharge itself.

name: Klink
pokedex: Two bodies comprise a fixed pair. The two minigears that mesh together are predetermined. Each will rebound from other minigears without meshing.

name: Treecko
pokedex: It makes its nest in a giant tree in the forest. It ferociously guards against anything nearing its territory. It is said to be the protector of the forest's trees.

name: Rhyhorn
pokedex: Once it starts running, it doesn't stop. Its tiny brain makes it so stupid that it can't remember why it started running in the first place.

name: Machop
pokedex: It continually undertakes strenuous training to master all forms of martial arts. Its strength lets it easily hoist a sumo wrestler onto its shoulders.

name: Nidoran♂
pokedex: The male Nidoran has developed muscles that freely move its ears in any direction. Even the slightest sound does not escape this Pokémon's notice.

name: Litten
pokedex: While grooming itself, it builds up fur inside its stomach. It sets the fur alight and spews fiery attacks, which change based on how it coughs.

name: Aron
pokedex: A Pokémon that is clad in steel armor. A new suit of armor is made when it evolves. The old, discarded armor is salvaged as metal for making iron products.

name: Nidoran♀
pokedex: Its highly toxic barbs are thought to have developed as protection for this small- bodied Pokémon. When enraged, it releases a horrible toxin from its horn.

name: Fennekin
pokedex: As it walks, it munches on a twig to fill itself with energy in place of a snack. It intimidates opponents by puffing hot air out of its roomy ears.

name: Mankey
pokedex: When it starts shaking and its nasal breathing turns rough, it's a sure sign of anger. However, since this happens instantly, there is no time to flee.

name: Honedge
pokedex: If anyone dares to grab its hilt, it wraps a blue cloth around that person's arm and drains that person's life energy completely.

name: Magby
pokedex: If a Magby is spouting yellow flames from its mouth, it is in good health. When it is fatigued, black smoke will be mixed in with the flames.

name: Cyndaquil
pokedex: It flares flames from its back to protect itself. The fire burns vigorously if the Pokémon is angry. When it is tired, it sputters with incomplete combustion.

name: Totodile
pokedex: Despite its small body, Totodile's jaws are very powerful. While it may think it is just playfully nipping, its bite has enough strength to cause serious injury.

name: Venipede
pokedex: Using the feelers on its head and tail, it picks up vibrations in the air to determine its prey's location and state. It is brutally aggressive.

name: Goomy
pokedex: Its source of protection is its slimy, germ-laden mucous membrane. Anyone who touches it will need some thorough hand-washing.

name: Larvitar
pokedex: A Larvitar is born deep under the ground. It must eat its way through the soil above and reach the surface for it to see its parents' faces.

name: Charmander
pokedex: The flame that burns at the tip of its tail is an indication of its emotions. The flame wavers when Charmander is happy, and blazes when it is enraged.

name: Gastly
pokedex: When exposed to a strong wind, a Gastly's gaseous body quickly dwindles away. They cluster under the eaves of houses to escape the ravages of wind.

name: Beldum
pokedex: When Beldum gather in a swarm, they move in perfect unison as if they were but one Pokémon. They communicate with each other using brain waves.

name: Jangmo-o
pokedex: It expresses its feelings by smacking its scales. Metallic sounds echo through the tall mountains where Jangmo-o live. They grow little by little battling one another.

name: Duskull
pokedex: A glare from its single scarlet eye makes even burly grown-ups freeze in utter fear. It is a nocturnal Pokémon that roams about under the cloak of darkness.

name: Bagon
pokedex: Although it is small, this Pokémon is very powerful because its body is a bundle of muscles. It launches head-butts with its ironlike skull.

name: Sandile
pokedex: It conceals itself in the sand and chomps down on the legs of any prey that unwarily walk over it. Its favorite food is Trapinch.

name: Gible
pokedex: It nests in horizontal holes warmed by geothermal heat. Foes who stray too close can expect to be pounced on and bitten.

name: Frigibax
pokedex: This Pokémon lives in forests and craggy areas. Using the power of its dorsal fin, it cools the inside of its nest like a refrigerator.

name: Dratini
pokedex: A Dratini continually molts and sloughs off its old skin. It does so because the life energy within its body steadily builds to reach uncontrollable levels.

name: Axew
pokedex: They mark their territory by leaving gashes in trees with their tusks. If a tusk breaks, a new one grows in quickly, harder and sturdier than the last.

name: Dreepy
pokedex: After being reborn as a ghost Pokémon, Dreepy wanders the areas it used to inhabit back when it was alive in prehistoric seas.

name: Pawniard
pokedex: Ignoring their injuries, groups attack by sinking the blades that cover their bodies into their prey. If battling dulls them, it sharpens them on stones by the river.

name: Deino
pokedex: Lacking sight, it's unaware of its surroundings, so it bumps into things and eats anything that moves. Approaching it carelessly is dangerous.

name: Krookodile
pokedex: Very violent Pokémon, they never allow their prey to escape. Their jaws are so powerful, they can crush the body of an automobile.

name: Gyarados
pokedex: It is an extremely vicious and violent Pokémon. When humans begin to fight, it will appear and burn everything to the ground with intensely hot flames.

name: Hydreigon
pokedex: This brutal Pokémon travels the skies on its six wings. The heads on their arms do not have brains. They use all three heads to consume and destroy everything.

name: Overqwil
pokedex: Its lancelike spikes and savage temperament have earned it the nickname “Sea Fiend”. It slurps up poison to nourish itself.

name: Sharpedo
pokedex: The vicious and sly gangster of the sea. Its skin is specially textured to minimize drag in water. Its speed tops out at over 75 miles per hour.

name: Basculin
pokedex: It used to be a common food source. The meat of red Basculin is on the fatty side and it's more popular with the youth. Its temperament is vicious and aggressive.

name: Arbok
pokedex: This Pokémon has a terrifically strong constricting power. It can even flatten steel oil drums. Once it wraps its body around its foe, escaping is impossible.

name: Druddigon
pokedex: It warms its body by absorbing sunlight with its wings. When its body temperature falls, it can no longer move. It uses its sharp claws to catch prey.

name: Annihilape
pokedex: When its anger rose beyond a critical point, this Pokémon gained power that is unfettered by the limits of its physical body.

name: Drednaw
pokedex: With jaws that can shear through steel rods, this highly aggressive Pokémon chomps down on its unfortunate prey.

name: Dragapult
pokedex: When it isn't battling, it keeps Dreepy in the holes on its horns. Once a fight starts, it launches the Dreepy like supersonic missiles.

name: Tyrantrum
pokedex: Thanks to its gargantuan jaws, which could shred thick metal plates as if they were paper, it was invincible in the ancient world it once inhabited.

name: Beartic
pokedex: It freezes its breath to create fangs and claws of ice to fight with. Very able in the water, it swims around in northern seas and catches prey.

name: Weavile
pokedex: They travel in groups of four or five, leaving signs for one another on trees and rocks. They bring down their prey with coordinated attacks.

name: Trevenant
pokedex: Through its roots, it exerts control over other trees. A deadly curse falls upon anyone cutting down trees in forests where Trevenant dwell.

name: Nidoking
pokedex: A Nidoking's thick tail packs enormously destructive power capable of toppling a metal transmission tower. Once it goes on a rampage, there is no stopping it.

name: Incineroar
pokedex: This Pokémon has a violent, selfish disposition. If it's not in the mood to listen, it will ignore its Trainer's orders with complete nonchalance.

name: Toxicroak
pokedex: Swaying and dodging the attacks of its foes, it weaves its flexible body in close, then lunges out with its poisonous claws.

name: Carvanha
pokedex: Carvanha attack ships in swarms, making them sink. Although it is said to be a very vicious Pokémon, it timidly flees as soon as it finds itself alone.

name: Tyranitar
pokedex: A Tyranitar is so overwhelmingly powerful, it can bring down a whole mountain to make its nest. It roams in mountains seeking new opponents to fight.

name: Kleavor
pokedex: A violent creature that fells trees with its crude axes and shields itself with hard stone. Should one encounter this Pokémon in the wild, one's only recourse is to flee.

name: Feraligatr
pokedex: It opens its huge mouth to intimidate enemies. In battle, it runs using its thick and powerful hind legs to charge the foe with incredible speed.

name: Baxcalibur
pokedex: It launches itself into battle by flipping upside down and spewing frigid air from its mouth. It finishes opponents off with its dorsal blade.

name: Sneasel
pokedex: Its sturdy, curved claws are ideal for traversing precipitous cliffs. From the tips of these claws drips a venom that infiltrates the nerves of any prey caught.

name: Salamence
pokedex: After many long years, its cellular structure underwent a sudden mutation to grow wings. When angered, it loses all thought and rampages out of control.

name: Bisharp
pokedex: This pitiless Pokémon commands a group of Pawniard to hound prey into immobility. It battles to become the boss, but will be driven from the group if it loses.

name: Zweilous
pokedex: After it has eaten up all the food in its territory, it moves on to another area. Whichever head eats more than the other gets to be the leader.

name: Vanilluxe
pokedex: Each of its two heads has a brain, and when they are in agreement, it attacks its enemies by exhaling a violent blizzard. It makes snow clouds inside its body.

name: Scolipede
pokedex: With quick movements, it chases down its foes, attacking relentlessly with its horns until it prevails. Then it finishes them off with deadly poison.

name: Scovillain
pokedex: The green head has turned vicious due to the spicy chemicals stimulating its brain. Once it goes on a rampage, there is no stopping it.

name: Kingambit
pokedex: Though it commands a massive army in battle, it's not skilled at devising complex strategies. It just uses brute strength to keep pushing.

name: Dusknoir
pokedex: This feared Pokémon is said to travel to worlds unknown. Some even believe that it takes lost spirits into its pliant body and guides them home.

name: Zebstrika
pokedex: When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates. It is dangerous when it's angry as it shoots lightning from its mane in all directions.

name: Gigalith
pokedex: The blasts of energy it makes from sunbeams have terrifying power. However, it's not able to fire its blasts at night or on rainy days.

name: Garchomp
pokedex: When it folds up its body and extends its wings, it looks like a jet plane. It is covered in fine scales that reduce drag, enabling it to fly at high speeds.

name: Haxorus
pokedex: They are kind but can be relentless when defending territory. Their sturdy tusks will stay sharp even if used to cut steel beams.

name: Fraxure
pokedex: Their tusks can shatter rocks. A broken tusk will not grow back, so it diligently sharpens its tusks on river rocks after the end of a battle.

name: Dragalge
pokedex: Their poison is strong enough to eat through the hull of a tanker. Tales are told of ships that wander into seas where Dragalge live, never to return.

name: Eelektross
pokedex: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean, with their sucker mouths.

name: Serperior
pokedex: They raise their heads to intimidate foes, but only give it their all when fighting powerful opponents who are not fazed by the glare from its noble eyes.

name: Staraptor
pokedex: When Staravia evolve into Staraptor, they leave the flock to live alone. It has a savage nature. It will courageously challenge foes that are much larger.

name: Luxray
pokedex: It has eyes which can see through anything. Luxray's ability to see through objects comes in handy when it's scouting for danger.

name: Machoke
pokedex: A belt is worn by a Machoke to keep its overwhelming power under control. Because it is so dangerous, no one has ever removed the belt.

name: Persian
pokedex: It looks down on everyone other than itself. In contrast to its lovely face, it is so brutal that it tortures its weakened prey rather than finishing them off.

name: Darmanitan
pokedex: When one is injured in a fierce battle, it transforms into a stone statue. Then it meditates and sharpens its mind and fights on mentally.

name: Deino
pokedex: Lacking sight, it's unaware of its surroundings, so it bumps into things and eats anything that moves. Approaching it carelessly is dangerous.

name: Venomoth
pokedex: Venomoth are nocturnal--they are only active at night. Their favorite prey are insects that gather around streetlights, attracted by the light in the darkness.

name: Samurott
pokedex: One swing of the seamitars attached to its armor can fell an opponent. A simple glare from one of them is enough to intimidate most enemies.

name: Duraludon
pokedex: Its body resembles polished metal, and it's both lightweight and strong. The only drawback is that it rusts easily.

name: Dragonite
pokedex: It can circle the globe in just 16 hours. It is a kindhearted Pokémon that leads lost and foundering ships in a storm to the safety of land.

name: Braviary
pokedex: Screaming a bloodcurdling battle cry, this huge and ferocious bird Pokémon goes out on the hunt.

name: Archaludon
pokedex: It gathers static electricity from its surroundings. The beams it launches when down on all fours are tremendously powerful.

name: Weezing
pokedex: By diluting its toxic gases with a special process, the highest grade of perfume can be extracted. To Weezing, gases emanating from garbage are the ultimate feast.

name: Tauros
pokedex: This Pokémon has a muscular body and excels at close-quarters combat. It uses its short horns to strike the opponent’s weak spots.

name: Tauros
pokedex: When heated by fire energy, its horns can get hotter than 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit. Those gored by them will suffer both wounds and burns.

name: Dracovish
pokedex: Powerful legs and jaws made it the apex predator of its time. Its own overhunting of its prey was what drove it to extinction.

name: Magmar
pokedex: In battle, it blows out intense flames from all over its body to intimidate its foe. These fiery bursts create heat waves that ignite grass and trees in the area.

name: Darmanitan
pokedex: Darmanitan takes this form when enraged. It won't stop spewing flames until its rage has settled, even if its body starts to melt.

name: Skuntank
pokedex: It attacks by spraying a horribly smelly fluid from the tip of its tail. The fluid smells worse the longer it is allowed to fester.

name: Sneasler
pokedex: Because of its wicked poison and daunting physical prowess, no other species could hope to best it on frozen highlands. It prefers solitude and doesn't form packs.

name: Charmeleon
pokedex: Without pity, its sharp claws destroy foes. If it encounters a strong enemy, it becomes agitated, and the flame on its tail flares with a bluish white color.

name: Scrafty
pokedex: Groups of them beat up anything that enters their territory. The one with the biggest crest is the group leader, and is the most respected.

name: Tauros
pokedex: This Pokémon blasts water from holes on the tips of its horns--the high-pressure jets pierce right through Tauros’s enemies.

name: Noivern
pokedex: They fly around on moonless nights and attack careless prey. The ultrasonic waves it emits from its ears can reduce a large boulder to pebbles.

name: Archeops
pokedex: They are intelligent and will cooperate to catch prey. When one Archeops had the prey cornered, another would swoop on it.

name: Mightyena
pokedex: In the wild, Mightyena live in a pack. They never defy their leader's orders. They defeat foes with perfectly coordinated teamwork.

name: Nidorino
pokedex: Its horn is harder than a diamond. If it senses a hostile presence, all the barbs on its back bristle up at once, and it challenges the foe with all its might.

name: Kommo-o
pokedex: Its rigid scales function as offense and defense. In the past, its scales were processed and used to make weapons and other valuable commodities.

name: Goodra
pokedex: It loathes solitude and is extremely clingy--it will fume and run riot if those dearest to it ever leave its side.

name: Arcanine
pokedex: Snaps at its foes with fangs cloaked in blazing flame. Despite its bulk, it deftly feints every which way, leading opponents on a deceptively merry chase.

name: Scizor
pokedex: A Scizor has a body with the hardness of steel. It is not easily fazed by ordinary sorts of attacks. It flaps its wings to regulate its body temperature.

name: Pawniard
pokedex: Ignoring their injuries, groups attack by sinking the blades that cover their bodies into their prey. If battling dulls them, it sharpens them on stones by the river.

name: Espathra
pokedex: It immobilizes opponents by bathing them in psychic power from its large eyes. Despite its appearance, it has a vicious temperament.

name: Runerigus
pokedex: A powerful curse was woven into an ancient painting. After absorbing the spirit of a Yamask, the painting began to move.

name: Rhyperior
pokedex: It can launch a rock held in its hand like a missile by tightening and then expanding its muscles instantaneously. Geodude are shot at rare times.

name: Beedrill
pokedex: A Beedrill is extremely territorial. For safety reasons, no one should ever approach its nest. If angered, they will attack in a swarm.

name: Goodra
pokedex: It gets picked on because it's meek. But then, whoever teased it gets to feel the full force of its horns and a good swatting from its thick tail.

name: Metang
pokedex: The claws tipping its arms pack the destructive power to tear through thick iron sheets as if they were silk. It flies at over 60 miles per hour.

name: Quilava
pokedex: It intimidates foes with intense gusts of flames and superheated air. Its quick nimbleness lets it dodge attacks even while scorching an enemy.

name: Pangoro
pokedex: It boasts superb physical strength. Those who wish to become Pangoro's Trainer have no choice but to converse with their fists.

name: Rampardos
pokedex: The result of repeated headbutts is a skull grown thick and hard. However, its brain has shrunk in size compared with Cranidos's.

name: Mienshao
pokedex: They use the long fur on their arms as a whip to strike their opponents. Its arm attacks come with such rapidity that they cannot even be seen.

name: Slowbro
pokedex: A Shellder bite set off a chemical reaction with the spices inside Slowbro's body, causing Slowbro to become a Poison-type Pokémon.

name: Qwilfish
pokedex: A form of Qwilfish from the distant past. Fishers detest this troublesome Pokémon because it sprays poison from its spines, getting it everywhere.

name: Metagross
pokedex: Metagross has four brains that are joined by a complex neural network. As a result of integration, this Pokémon is smarter than a supercomputer.

name: Salandit
pokedex: It burns its bodily fluids to create a sweet-smelling poisonous gas. When its enemies become disoriented from inhaling the gas, it attacks them.

name: Rillaboom
pokedex: By drumming, it taps into the power of its special tree stump. The roots of the stump follow its direction in battle.

name: Dhelmise
pokedex: The soul of seaweed adrift in the waves became reborn as this Pokémon. It maintains itself with new infusions of seabed detritus and seaweed.

name: Arcanine
pokedex: This fleet-footed Pokémon is said to run over 6,200 miles in a single day and night. The fire that blazes wildly within its body is its source of power.

name: Ursaluna
pokedex: Swampy terrain gives Ursaluna its burly physique and newfound capacity to manipulate peat at will.

name: Revavroom
pokedex: It creates a gas out of poison and minerals from rocks. It then detonates the gas in its cylinders- now numbering eight-to generate energy.

name: Bewear
pokedex: This Pokémon has the habit of hugging its companions. Many Trainers have left this world after their spines were squashed by its hug.

name: Qwilfish
pokedex: A Qwilfish uses the pressure of water it swallows to shoot toxic quills all at once from all over its body. It finds swimming to be somewhat challenging.

name: Salazzle
pokedex: For some reason, only females have been found. It creates a reverse harem of male Salandit to live with. Its poisonous gas is filled with pheromones.

name: Chesnaught
pokedex: It shields its allies from danger with its own body. When it takes a defensive posture with its fists guarding its face, it can withstand a bomb blast.

name: Bruxish
pokedex: It stuns its prey with its psychic powers and then grinds them to mush with its strong teeth. Even Shellder's shell is no match for it.

name: Aegislash
pokedex: In this defensive stance, Aegislash uses its steel body and a force field of spectral power to reduce the damage of any attack.

name: Toxapex
pokedex: Those attacked by Toxapex's poison will suffer intense pain for three days and three nights. Post-recovery, there will be some aftereffects.

name: Sandile
pokedex: It conceals itself in the sand and chomps down on the legs of any prey that unwarily walk over it. Its favorite food is Trapinch.

name: Granbull
pokedex: It has a particularly well-developed lower jaw. The huge fangs are heavy, causing it to tilt its head. Unless it is startled, it will not try to bite.

name: Hippowdon
pokedex: It is surprisingly quick to anger. It brandishes its gaping mouth in a display of fearsome strength and raises vast quantities of sand while attacking.

name: Tauros
pokedex: It is not satisfied unless it is rampaging at all times. If there is no opponent for Tauros to battle, it will charge at thick trees and knock them down to calm itself.

name: Masquerain
pokedex: It intimidates foes with the large eyelike patterns on its antennae. Because it can't fly if its wings get wet, it shelters itself from rain under large trees and eaves.

name: Seviper
pokedex: Seviper and Zangoose are eternal rivals. It counters a Zangoose's dazzling agility with its swordlike tail, which also oozes a horrible poison.

name: Murkrow
pokedex: Murkrow were feared as the alleged bearers of ill fortune. It shows strong interest in anything that sparkles. It will even try to steal rings from women.

name: Armaldo
pokedex: Armaldo usually lives on land. However, when it hunts for prey, it dives beneath the ocean. It swims around using its two large wings.

name: Slowbro
pokedex: Its tail has a Shellder firmly attached with a bite. As a result, the tail can't be used for fishing anymore. This forces it to reluctantly swim and catch prey.

name: Brambleghast
pokedex: It will open the branches of its head to envelop its prey. Once it absorbs all the life energy it needs, it expels the prey and discards it.

name: Tyrunt
pokedex: Its immense jaws have enough destructive force that it can chew up a car. If something happens that it doesn't like, it throws a tantrum and runs wild.

name: Muk
pokedex: It prefers warm and humid habitats. In the summertime, the toxic substances in its body intensify, making Muk reek like putrid kitchen garbage.

name: Ceruledge
pokedex: The fiery blades on its arms burn fiercely with the lingering resentment of a sword wielder who fell before accomplishing their goal.

name: Zoroark
pokedex: Heedless of its own safety, Zoroark attacks its nemeses with a bitter energy so intense, it lacerates Zoroark's own body.

name: Lokix
pokedex: When it decides to fight all out, it stands on its previously folded legs to enter Showdown Mode. It neutralizes its enemies in short order.

name: Basculegion
pokedex: Clads itself in the souls of comrades that perished before fulfilling their goals of journeying upstream. No other species in all Hisui's rivers is Basculegion's equal.

name: Roserade
pokedex: Its sweet aroma attracts prey. With the movements of a dancer, it strikes with whips that are densely lined with poison thorns.

name: Malamar
pokedex: It lures prey close with hypnotic motions, then wraps its tentacles around it before finishing it off with digestive fluids. It forces others to do whatever it wants.

name: Drakloak
pokedex: It's capable of flying faster than 120 mph. It battles alongside Dreepy and dotes on them until they successfully evolve.

name: Aggron
pokedex: Its iron horns grow longer a little at a time. They are used to determine the Aggron's age. The gouges in its armor are worn with pride as mementos from battles.

name: Veluza
pokedex: Veluza has excellent regenerative capabilities. It sheds spare flesh from its body to boost its agility, then charges at its prey.

name: Absol
pokedex: It sharply senses even subtle changes in the sky and the land to predict natural disasters. It is a long-lived Pokémon that has a life-span of 100 years.

name: Conkeldurr
pokedex: They use concrete pillars as walking canes. Rather than rely solely on force, they master moves that utilize the centrifugal force of spinning concrete.

name: Tangrowth
pokedex: It ensnares prey by extending arms made of vines. Even if one of its arms is eaten, it's fine. The Pokémon regenerates quickly and will go right back to normal.

name: Victreebel
pokedex: The long vine extending from its head is waved about as if it were a living thing to attract prey. When an unsuspecting victim approaches, it is swallowed whole.

name: Honchkrow
pokedex: Becoming active at night, it is known to swarm with numerous Murkrow in tow. It is said that it never forgives the mistakes of its cronies.

name: Stufful
pokedex: Despite its adorable appearance, when it gets angry and flails about, its arms and legs could knock a pro wrestler sprawling. It's an incredibly dangerous Pokémon.

name: Hydrapple
pokedex: These capricious syrpents have banded together. On the rare occasion that their moods align, their true power is unleashed.

name: Zoroark
pokedex: Bonds between these Pokémon are very strong. It protects the safety of its pack by tricking its opponents. They defend their lair with illusory scenery.

name: Sirfetch'd
pokedex: Only Farfetch'd that have survived many battles can attain this evolution. When this Pokémon's leek withers, it will retire from combat.

name: Dragonair
pokedex: A Dragonair stores an enormous amount of energy inside its body. It is said to alter the weather around it by loosing energy from the crystals on its neck and tail.

name: Heracross
pokedex: They gather in forests seeking the sweet sap of trees. It is completely clad in a steel-hard shell. It is proud of its horn, which it uses to fling foes.

name: Drapion
pokedex: Possessing a sturdy build, it takes pride in its strength. It has the power in its clawed arms to make scrap out of a car.

name: Kabutops
pokedex: Kabutops once swam underwater to hunt  for prey. It was apparently evolving from being a water dweller to living on land as evident from changes in its gills and legs.

name: Klang
pokedex: A minigear and big gear comprise its body. Spinning minigears are rotated at high speed and repeatedly fired away. It is dangerous if the gears don't return.

name: Hitmonlee
pokedex: Its legs freely stretch and contract. Using these springlike limbs, it bowls over foes with devastating kicks. After battle, it rubs down its tired legs.

name: Falinks
pokedex: Five of them are troopers, and one is the brass. The brass's orders are absolute.

name: Mudsdale
pokedex: Its heavy, mud-covered kicks are its best means of attack, and it can reduce large trucks to scrap without breaking a sweat.

name: Weezing
pokedex: Long ago, when droves of factories fouled the air with pollution, it changed into this form for some reason. It consumes air pollutant particles, expelling clean air.

name: Lairon
pokedex: When two Lairon meet in the wild, they fight for territory by bashing into each other with their steel bodies. The sound of their collision carries for miles.

name: Crustle
pokedex: Competing for territory, Crustle fight viciously. The one whose boulder is broken is the loser of the battle and begins to weaken.

name: Gliscor
pokedex: Gliscor observes prey while hanging upside down from branches. Its flight is soundless. When the chance presents itself, it swoops!

name: Passimian
pokedex: They battle with hard berries for weapons. They form groups of about 20 individuals. Their techniques are passed from the boss to the group, generation upon generation.

name: Aurorus
pokedex: Using the diamond-shaped crystals on its body it can instantly create a wall of ice to block an opponent's attack, or encase them in ice.

name: Sliggoo
pokedex: This Pokémon's mucous can dissolve anything. Toothless, it sprays mucous on its prey. Once they're nicely dissolved, it slurps them up.

name: Charizard
pokedex: A Charizard flies about in search of strong opponents. It breathes intense flames that can melt any material. However, it will never torch a weaker foe.

name: Donphan
pokedex: A Donphan is so strong it can easily haul a dump truck. Its hide has toughened to a rock-hard state. An ordinary sort of attack won't even leave a scratch.

name: Talonflame
pokedex: In the fever of an exciting battle, it showers embers from the gaps between its feathers and takes to the air. It finishes its prey off with a colossal kick.

name: Quaquaval
pokedex: A single kick from a Quaquaval can send a truck rolling. This Pokémon uses its powerful legs to perform striking dances from far-off lands.

name: Gabite
pokedex: Shiny objects are its passion. It can be found in its cave, scarcely moving, its gaze fixed on the jewels it's amassed or Carbink it has caught.

name: Sceptile
pokedex: In the jungle, its power is without equal. This Pokémon carefully grows trees and plants. It regulates its body temperature by basking in sunlight.

name: Hakamo-o
pokedex: It sheds and regrows its scales on a continuous basis. The scales become harder each time they're regrown. Its scaly punches tear its foes to shreds.

name: Bastiodon
pokedex: Their rock-hard faces serve to protect them from any frontral attacks. When attacked, they form a wall. They shielded their young in that way.

name: Throh
pokedex: When it tightens its belt, it becomes stronger. Wild Throh use vines to weave their own belts. It changes belts as it gets more powerful.

name: Pinsir
pokedex: Their pincers are strong enough to shatter thick logs. Because they dislike cold, Pinsir burrow and sleep under the ground on chilly nights.

name: Rhydon
pokedex: Its horn, which rotates like a drill, destroys tall buildings with one strike. It stands on its hind legs, and its brain is well developed.

name: Gastrodon
pokedex: It appears on shallow-water beaches to eat sand for nourishment. Should one Gastrodon encounter another of a different color, a fierce battle will ensue.

name: Steelix
pokedex: Steelix live even further underground than Onix. This Pokémon is known to dig toward the earth's core, reaching a depth of over six-tenths of a mile underground.

name: Palossand
pokedex: Possessed people controlled by this Pokémon transformed its sand mound into a castle. As it evolved, its power to curse grew ever stronger.

name: Carracosta
pokedex: They can live both in the ocean and on land. Incredible jaw strength enables them to chew up steel beams and rocks along with their prey.

name: Kingdra
pokedex: It sleeps quietly, deep on the seafloor. When it comes up to the surface, it creates a huge whirlpool that can swallow even ships.

name: Graveler
pokedex: They descend from mountains by tumbling down steep slopes. They are so brutal, they smash aside obstructing trees and massive boulders with thunderous tackles.

name: Slaking
pokedex: Hordes of Slaking gather around trees when fruits come into season. They wait around patiently for ripened fruits to fall out of the trees.

name: Turtonator
pokedex: The shell on its back is chemically unstable and explodes violently if struck. The hole in its stomach is its weak point. It gushes fire from its nostrils.

name: Arctovish
pokedex: Though it's able to capture prey by freezing its surroundings, it has trouble eating the prey afterward because its mouth is on top of its head.

name: Raichu
pokedex: If it stores too much electricity, its behavior turns aggressive. To avoid this, it occasionally discharges excess energy and calms itself down.

name: Axew
pokedex: They mark their territory by leaving gashes in trees with their tusks. If a tusk breaks, a new one grows in quickly, harder and sturdier than the last.

name: Houndoom
pokedex: In a Houndoom pack, the one with its horns raked sharply back serves a leadership role. They choose their leader by fighting among themselves.

name: Machamp
pokedex: It is impossible to defend against punches and chops doled out by its four arms. Its fighting spirit flares up when it faces a tough opponent.

name: Cetitan
pokedex: Ice energy builds up in the horn on its upper jaw, causing the horn to reach cryogenic temperatures that freeze its surroundings.

name: Emboar
pokedex: It is adept at using many different moves. It can throw a fire punch by setting its fists on fire with its fiery chin. It cares deeply about its friends.

name: Aerodactyl
pokedex: Aerodactyl is a Pokémon from the age of dinosaurs. It was regenerated from DNA extracted from amber. It is imagined to have been the king of the skies.

name: Spiritomb
pokedex: A Pokémon that was formed by 108 spirits. Its constant mischief and misdeeds resulted in it being bound to an Odd Keystone by a mysterious spell.

name: Hatterene
pokedex: It emits psychic power strong enough to cause headaches as a deterrent to the approach of others.

name: Skrelp
pokedex: Camouflaged as rotten kelp, it hides from foes while storing up power for its evolution. They spray liquid poison on prey that approach unawares.

name: Gallade
pokedex: A master of courtesy and swordsmanship, it fights using extending swords on its elbows when trying to protect someone. It can sense what its foe is thinking.

name: Golisopod
pokedex: It battles skillfully with its six arms, with a flashing slash of its giant sharp claws, it cleaves seawater--or even air--right in two.

name: Doublade
pokedex: When Honedge evolves, it divides into two swords. The complex attack patterns of its two swords are unstoppable, even against those skilled at swordplay.

name: Obstagoon
pokedex: Its voice is staggering in volume. Obstagoon has a tendency to take on a threatening posture and shout--this move is known as Obstruct.

name: Venipede
pokedex: Using the feelers on its head and tail, it picks up vibrations in the air to determine its prey's location and state. It is brutally aggressive.

name: Krokorok
pokedex: They move in groups of a few individuals. Thanks to the special membrane covering its eyes, it can see its surroundings clearly, even in the dead of night.

name: Tentacruel
pokedex: It lives in complex rock formations on the ocean floor and traps prey using its 80 tentacles. Its red orbs glow when it grows excited or agitated.

name: Corviknight
pokedex: This Pokémon reigns supreme in the skies of the Galar region. The black luster of its steel body could drive terror into the heart of any foe.

name: Scraggy
pokedex: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck. Its skull is massively thick.

name: Flamigo
pokedex: Thanks to a behavior of theirs known as “synchronizing,” an entire flock of these Pokémon can attack simultaneously in perfect harmony.

name: Garbodor
pokedex: Beware the poisonous liquid it shoots from its right arm. If even a little of it gets on you, you'll experience the full effects of this unidentified toxin.

name: Ursaring
pokedex: In forests, it is said that there are many streams and towering trees where an Ursaring gathers food. It walks through its forest collecting food every day.

name: Stonjourner
pokedex: It stands in grasslands, watching the sun's descent from zenith to horizon. This Pokémon has a talent for delivering dynamic kicks.

name: Mamoswine
pokedex: A frozen Mamoswine was dug from ice dating back 10,000 years. It woke up to much amazement. This Pokémon has been around for a long, long, long time.

name: Sandaconda
pokedex: When it contracts its body, over 220 pounds of sand sprays from its nose. If it ever runs out of sand, it becomes disheartened.

name: Blaziken
pokedex: It learns martial arts that use punches and kicks. Every several years, its old feathers burn off, and new, supple feathers grow back in their place.

name: Escavalier
pokedex: Wearing the shell covering they stole from Shelmet, they defend themselves and attack with two lances. The steel armor protects their whole body.

name: Crabominable
pokedex: It aimed for the top but got lost and ended up on a snowy mountain. Being forced to endure the cold, this Pokémon evolved and grew thick fur.

name: Glimmora
pokedex: Glimmora's petals are made of crystallized poison energy. It has recently become evident that these petals resemble Tera Jewels.

name: Farigiraf
pokedex: Now that the brain waves from the head and tail are synced up, the psychic power of this Pokémon is 10 times stronger than Girafarig's.

name: Copperajah
pokedex: They came over from another region long ago and worked together with humans. Their green skin is resistant to water.

name: Flygon
pokedex: The flapping of its wings sounds like singing. To prevent detection by enemies, it hides itself by flapping up a cloud of desert sand.

name: Skorupi
pokedex: It grips prey with its tail claws and injects poison. It tenaciously hangs on until the poison takes. It can survive a year without food.

name: Avalugg
pokedex: The armor of ice covering its lower jaw puts steel to shame and can shatter rocks with ease.

name: Stunfisk
pokedex: Its conspicuous lips lure prey in as it lies in wait in the mud. When prey gets close, Stunfisk clamps its jagged steel fins down on them.

name: Pawmot
pokedex: This Pokémon normally is slow to react, but once it enters battle, it will strike down its enemies with lightning-fast movements.

name: Gorebyss
pokedex: A Gorebyss siphons the body fluids of prey through its thin, tubular mouth. Its light pink body color turns vivid when it finishes feeding.

name: Linoone
pokedex: This very aggressive Pokémon will recklessly challenge opponents stronger than itself. It uses its long tongue to taunt them to then tackle forcefully.

name: Grimmsnarl
pokedex: With the hair wrapped around its body helping to enhance its muscles, this Pokémon can overwhelm even Machamp.

name: Umbreon
pokedex: Umbreon evolved from exposure to the moon's energy pulses. It lurks in darkness and waits for its foes to move. The rings on its body glow when it leaps to attack.

name: Dracozolt
pokedex: In ancient times, it was unbeatable thanks to its powerful lower body, but it went extinct anyway after it depleted all its plant-based food sources.

name: Forretress
pokedex: It keeps itself inside its steel shell. The shell is opened when it is catching prey, but it is so quick that the shell's inside cannot be seen.

name: Sawk
pokedex: The sound of Sawk punching boulders and trees can be heard all the way from the mountains where they train. Disturbing their training angers them.

name: Maschiff
pokedex: Its well-developed jaw and fangs are strong enough to crunch through boulders, and its thick fat makes for an excellent defense.

name: Hitmontop
pokedex: Its technique of kicking while spinning is a remarkable mix of both offense and defense. Hitmontop travel faster spinning than they do walking.

name: Sneasel
pokedex: A Sneasel scales trees by punching its hooked claws into the bark. It seeks out unguarded nests and steals eggs for food while the parents are away.

name: Hariyama
pokedex: It has the habit of challenging others without hesitation to tests of strength. It's been known to stand on train tracks and stop trains using forearm thrusts.

name: Klawf
pokedex: Klawf hangs upside-down from cliffs, waiting for prey. But Klawf can't remain in this position for long because its blood rushes to its head.

name: Shelgon
pokedex: It hardly eats while it awaits evolution. It becomes hardier by enduring hunger. Its shell peels off the instant it begins to evolve.

name: Shiftry
pokedex: It is said to arrive on chilly, wintry winds. Feared from long ago as the guardian of forests, this Pokémon lives in a deep forest where people do not venture.

name: Arctibax
pokedex: Arctibax freezes the air around it, protecting its face with an ice mask and turning its dorsal fin into a blade of ice.

name: Lucario
pokedex: It understands human speech. It is said that no foe can remain invisible to Lucario, since it can detect Auras. Even foes it could not otherwise see.

name: Samurott
pokedex: Hard of heart and deft of blade, this rare form of Samurott is a product of the Pokémon's evolution in the region of Hisui.

name: Empoleon
pokedex: The three horns that extend from its beak attest to its power. It avoids unnecessary disputes, but it will decimate anything that threatens its pride.

name: Simisage
pokedex: Ill tempered, it attacks enemies by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.

name: Grafaiai
pokedex: Each Grafaiai paints its own individual pattern, and it will paint that same pattern over and over again throughout its life.

name: Centiskorch
pokedex: When it heats up, its body temperature reaches about 1,500 degrees Fahrenheit. It lashes its body like a whip and launches itself at enemies.

name: Dusclops
pokedex: It is thought that its body is hollow with only a spectral ball of fire burning inside. However, no one has been able to confirm this theory as fact.

name: Exeggutor
pokedex: Originally from the tropics, Exeggutor's heads grow larger from exposure to strong sunlight. It is said that when the heads fall, they group to form an Exeggcute.

name: Houndour
pokedex: Houndour communicate with each other using a variety of cries to corner their prey. This Pokémon's remarkable teamwork is simply unparalleled.

name: Primeape
pokedex: When it becomes furious, its blood circulation becomes more robust, and its muscles are made stronger. But it also becomes much less intelligent.

name: Perrserker
pokedex: What appears to be an iron helmet is actually hardened hair. This Pokémon lives for the thrill of battle.

name: Nidoqueen
pokedex: It is adept at sending foes flying with harsh tackles using its tough, scaly body. This Pokémon is at its strongest when it is defending its young.

name: Golem
pokedex: It fires rocks charged with electricity. Even if the rock isn't fired that accurately, just grazing an opponent will cause numbness and fainting.

name: Sliggoo
pokedex: A creature given to melancholy. Its metallic shell developed as a result of the mucus on its skin reacting with the iron in Hisui's water.

name: Hypno
pokedex: The arcing movement and glitter of the pendulum in a Hypno's hand lull the foe into deep hypnosis. While searching for prey, it polishes the pendulum.

name: Sableye
pokedex: It digs branching holes in caves using its sharp claws in search of food--raw gems. A Sableye lurks in darkness and is seen only rarely.

name: Barraskewda
pokedex: This Pokémon has a jaw that's as sharp as a spear and as strong as steel. Apparently Barraskewda's flesh is surprisingly tasty, too.

name: Mabosstiff
pokedex: Mabosstiff loves playing with children. Though usually gentle, it takes on an intimidating look when protecting its family.

name: Golurk
pokedex: Golurk were created to protect people and Pokémon by an ancient civilisation. Removing the seal on its chest makes its internal energy go out of control.

name: Decidueye
pokedex: The air stored inside the rachises of Decidueye's feathers insulates the Pokémon against Hisui's extreme cold.

name: Wailord
pokedex: It breathes through nostrils that it raises above the sea. By inhaling to its maximum capacity, a Wailord can dive close to 10,000 feet beneath the waves.

name: Cacturne
pokedex: After spending thousands of years in harsh deserts, its blood transformed into the same substances as sand. It is nocturnal, so it hunts at night.

name: Sandslash
pokedex: It curls up in a ball to protect itself from enemy attacks. It also curls up to prevent heatstroke during the daytime when temperatures rise sharply.

name: Swalot
pokedex: Its powerful stomach acid is capable of digesting almost anything. The one thing in the whole world a Swalot can't digest is its own stomach.

name: Flapple
pokedex: It ate a sour apple, and that induced its evolution. In its cheeks, it stores an acid capable of causing chemical burns.

name: Electivire
pokedex: When it gets excited, it thumps its chest. With every thud, thunder roars, electric sparks shower all around and blue sparks begin to crackle between its horns.

name: Exeggutor
pokedex: Alola is the best environment for this Pokémon. Local people take pride in its appearance, saying this is how Exeggutor ought to look.

name: Koffing
pokedex: Getting up close to a Koffing will give you a chance to observe, through its thin skin, the toxic gases swirling inside. It blows up at the slightest stimulation.

name: Solrock
pokedex: Solar energy is the source of this  Pokémon's power. On sunny days, groups of Solrock line up facing the sun and absorb its light.

name: Probopass
pokedex: It freely controls three units called Mini-Noses using magnetic force. With them, it can attack its foes from three directions.

name: Golem
pokedex: It is said to live in volcanic craters on mountain peaks. Once a year, it sheds its hide and grows larger. The shed hide crumbles and returns to the soil.

name: Eelektrik
pokedex: These Pokémon have a big appetite. It wraps itself around its prey and paralyzes it with electricity from the round spots on its sides. Then it chomps.

name: Grapploct
pokedex: A body made up of nothing but muscle makes the grappling moves this Pokémon performs with its tentacles tremendously powerful.

name: Banette
pokedex: An abandoned plush doll became this Pokémon. They are said to live in garbage dumps and wander about in search of the children that threw them away.

name: Decidueye
pokedex: Decidueye is cool and cautious. It fires arrow quills from its wings with such precision, they can pierce a pebble at distances of over a hundred yards.

name: Ariados
pokedex: Its feet are tipped with tiny hooked claws that enable it to scuttle on ceilings and vertical walls. It constricts its foe with thin and strong silk webbing.

name: Vileplume
pokedex: In seasons when it produces more pollen, the air around a Vileplume turns yellow with the powder as it walks. The pollen is highly toxic and causes paralysis.

name: Toucannon
pokedex: When it battles, within its beak, its internal gases ignite, explosively launching seeds with enough power to pulverize boulders.

name: Dreepy
pokedex: After being reborn as a ghost Pokémon, Dreepy wanders the areas it used to inhabit back when it was alive in prehistoric seas.

name: Gengar
pokedex: Deep in the night, your shadow cast by a streetlight may suddenly overtake you. It is actually a Gengar running past you, pretending to be your shadow.

name: Frigibax
pokedex: This Pokémon lives in forests and craggy areas. Using the power of its dorsal fin, it cools the inside of its nest like a refrigerator.

name: Bombirdier
pokedex: Bombirdier uses the apron on its chest to bundle up food, which it carries back to its nest. It enjoys dropping things that make loud noises.

name: Amoonguss
pokedex: It lures prey close by dancing and waving its arm caps, which resemble Poké Balls, in a swaying motion, but very few Pokémon are fooled by this.

name: Typhlosion
pokedex: Said to purify lost, forsaken souls with its flames and guide them to the afterlife. It's believed its form was influenced by the energy of Mt. Coronet in ancient times.

name: Wyrdeer
pokedex: The black orbs shine with an uncanny light when it is erecting invisible barriers. The fur shed from its beard retains heat and is useful for winter clothing.

name: Swampert
pokedex: If it senses the approach of a storm and a tidal wave, it protects its seaside nest by piling up boulders. It swims as fast as a jet ski.

name: Greninja
pokedex: It appears and vanishes with a ninja's grace. It toys with its enemies using swift movements, while slicing them with throwing stars made of compressed water.

name: Nidoran♀
pokedex: Its highly toxic barbs are thought to have developed as protection for this small- bodied Pokémon. When enraged, it releases a horrible toxin from its horn.

name: Gumshoos
pokedex: When it finds a trace of its prey, it patiently stakes out the location... but as it's diurnal, it's always snoozing by nightfall.

name: Boltund
pokedex: This Pokémon generates electricity and channels it into its legs to keep them going strong. Boltund can run nonstop for three full days.

name: Jellicent
pokedex: They propel themselves by expelling absorbed seawater from their bodies. It's said there's a castle of ships Jellicent have sunk on the seafloor.

name: Dustox
pokedex: It is a nocturnal Pokémon that flies from fields and mountains to the attraction of streetlights at night. It looses highly toxic powder from its wings.

name: Cranidos
pokedex: A lifelong jungle dweller from 100 million years ago, its skull is as hard as iron.  It would snap obstructing trees with headbutts.

name: Avalugg
pokedex: The way several Bergmite huddle on its back make it look like an aircraft carrier made of ice. Its cumbersome frame crushes anything that stands in its way.

name: Milotic
pokedex: It is said to live at the bottom of large lakes. Considered to be the most beautiful of all Pokémon, it has been depicted in paintings and statues.

name: Braviary
pokedex: For the sake of its friends, this brave warrior of the sky will not stop battling, even if it is injured. One can carry a car while flying.

name: Seismitoad
pokedex: It increases the power of its punches by vibrating the bumps on its fists. They can also shoot paralyzing liquid from their head bumps.

name: Dudunsparce
pokedex: This Pokémon uses its hard tail to make its nest by boring holes into bedrock deep underground. The nest can reach lengths of over six miles.

name: Mankey
pokedex: When it starts shaking and its nasal breathing turns rough, it's a sure sign of anger. However, since this happens instantly, there is no time to flee.

name: Gible
pokedex: It nests in horizontal holes warmed by geothermal heat. Foes who stray too close can expect to be pounced on and bitten.

name: Gothitelle
pokedex: Starry skies thousands of light-years away are visible in the space distorted by their intense psychic power. When it learns its Trainer's life span, it cries in sadness.

name: Orthworm
pokedex: When attacked, this Pokémon will wield the tendrils on its body like fists and pelt the opponent with a storm of punches.

name: Zangoose
pokedex: When it battles, it stands on its hind legs and attacks with its sharply clawed forelegs. Its fur bristles if it encounters any Seviper.

name: Kangaskhan
pokedex: If you come across a young Kangaskhan playing by itself, never try to catch it. The baby's parent is sure to be in the area, and it will become violently enraged.

name: Alakazam
pokedex: While it has strong psychic abilities and high intelligence, an Alakazam's muscles are very weak. It uses psychic power to move its body.

name: Sigilyph
pokedex: The guardians of an ancient city, they always fly the same route while keeping watch for invaders. They use their psychic power to attack enemies.

name: Omastar
pokedex: An Omastar uses its tentacles to capture its prey. It is believed to have become extinct because its shell grew too large, making its movements slow and ponderous.

name: Meganium
pokedex: The fragrance of a Meganium's flower soothes and calms emotions. In battle, it gives off more of its becalming scent to blunt the foe's fighting spirit.

name: Quagsire
pokedex: A Quagsire hunts by leaving its mouth wide open in water and waiting for its prey to blunder in. Because it doesn't move, it does not get very hungry.

name: Florges
pokedex: The flower it's holding can no longer be found blooming anywhere. It's also thought to contain terrifying power.

name: Drifblim
pokedex: Even while under careful observation, large flocks of Drifblim flying at dusk will inexplicably disappear from view. No one knows where they go.

name: Barbaracle
pokedex: Barbaracle's legs and hands have minds of their own, and they will move independently. But they usually follow the head's orders.

name: Sandslash
pokedex: It uses large, hooked claws to cut a path through deep snow as it runs. On snowy mountains, this Sandslash is faster than any other Pokémon.

name: Glalie
pokedex: A Glalie has the power to instantaneously freeze moisture in the atmosphere. A dazzling cloud of diamondlike ice crystals forms around its body.

name: Stantler
pokedex: Stantler's magnificent antlers were once traded at high prices as works of art. As a result, this Pokémon was hunted close to extinction.

name: Sylveon
pokedex: Its ribbonlike feelers give off an aura that weakens hostility in its prey, causing them to let down their guard. A moment later, it pounces.

name: Kingler
pokedex: It waves its huge, oversized claw in the air to communicate with others. But since the claw is so heavy, this Pokémon quickly tires.

name: Lycanroc
pokedex: It has a calm and collected demeanor. It swiftly closes in on its prey, then slices them with the rocks in its mane.

name: Cinderace
pokedex: It juggles a pebble with its feet, turning it into a burning soccer ball. Its shots strike opponents hard and leave them scorched.

name: Garganacl
pokedex: Garganacl will rub its fingertips together and sprinkle injured Pokémon with salt. Even severe wounds will promptly heal afterward.

name: Toxtricity
pokedex: When this Pokémon sounds as if it's strumming a guitar, it's actually clawing at the protrusions on its chest to generate electricity.

name: Altaria
pokedex: It hums in a beautiful soprano voice. It flies among white clouds in the blue sky. It launches intensely hot fireballs from its mouth.

name: Cursola
pokedex: Its shell is overflowing with its heightened otherworldly energy. The ectoplasm serves as protection for this Pokémon's core spirit.

name: Excadrill
pokedex: More than 300 feet below the surface, they build mazelike nests. Their activity can be destructive to subway tunnels, but it can also help with construction.

name: Marowak
pokedex: The cursed flames that light up the bone carried by this Pokémon are said to cause both mental and physical pain that will never fade.

name: Dratini
pokedex: A Dratini continually molts and sloughs off its old skin. It does so because the life energy within its body steadily builds to reach uncontrollable levels.

name: Arctozolt
pokedex: The shaking of its freezing upper half is what generates its electricity. It has a hard time walking around.

name: Delphox
pokedex: It gazes into the flame at the tip of its branch to achieve a focused state, which allows it to see into the future. It uses psychic power to incinerate its foes.

name: Lampent
pokedex: This ominous Pokémon is feared. Through cities it wanders, searching for the spirits of the fallen. The spirits it absorbs fuel its baleful fire.

name: Bouffalant
pokedex: Their fluffy fur absorbs damage, even if they strike foes with a fierce headbutt. Their headbutts have enough destructive force to derail a train.

name: Walrein
pokedex: To protect its herd, the leader battles anything that invades its territory, even at the cost of its life. Its tusks may snap off in battle.

name: Abomasnow
pokedex: It lives a quiet life on mountains that are perpetually covered in snow. It hides itself by whipping up blizzards. It is also known as “The Ice Monster.”

name: Klinklang
pokedex: Its red core functions as an energy tank. It is rotated at high speed for a rapid energy charge. It fires the charged energy through its spikes into an area.

name: Polteageist
pokedex: This species lives in antique teapots. Most pots are forgeries, but on rare occasions, an authentic work is found.

name: Ekans
pokedex: An Ekans curls itself up in a spiral while it rests. This position allows it to quickly respond to an enemy from any direction with a threat from its upraised head.

name: Gurdurr
pokedex: They strengthen their bodies by carrying steel beams. This Pokémon is so muscular and strongly built that even a group of wrestlers could not make it budge an inch.

name: Croconaw
pokedex: Once its jaws clamp down on its foe, it will absolutely not let go. Because the tips of its fangs are forked back like fishhooks, they become irremovably embedded.

name: Duskull
pokedex: A glare from its single scarlet eye makes even burly grown-ups freeze in utter fear. It is a nocturnal Pokémon that roams about under the cloak of darkness.

name: Farfetch'd
pokedex: The stalks of leeks are thicker and longer in the Galar region. Brave Farfetch'd warriors that adapted to these stalks took on a unique form.

name: Mienfoo
pokedex: They have mastered elegant combos. As they concentrate, their battle moves become swifter and more precise. What it lacks in power, it makes up for in quantity.

name: Linoone
pokedex: It is exceedingly fast if it only has to run in a straight line. When it spots pond- dwelling prey underwater, it quickly leaps in and catches it with its sharp claws.

name: Claydol
pokedex: A Claydol sleeps while hovering in midair. Its arms are separate from its body. They are kept floating by the Pokémon's manipulation of psychic power.

name: Hitmonchan
pokedex: A Hitmonchan is said to possess the spirit of a boxer who aimed to become the world champion. Having an indomitable spirit means that it will never give up.

name: Carnivine
pokedex: Hanging from branches using its tentacles, it looks like a plant. It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling saliva, then chomps down.

name: Bagon
pokedex: Although it is small, this Pokémon is very powerful because its body is a bundle of muscles. It launches head-butts with its ironlike skull.

name: Gligar
pokedex: It glides without making a single sound. It grasps the face of its foe using its hind and large front claws, then stabs with its poison barb.

name: Electrode
pokedex: They appear in great numbers at electric power plants. Because they feed on electricity, they cause massive and chaotic blackouts in nearby cities.

name: Cofagrigus
pokedex: Grave robbers who mistake them for real coffins and get too close end up trapped inside their bodies. Their bodies are covered in pure gold.

name: Gholdengo
pokedex: It has a sturdy body made up of stacked coins. Gholdengo overwhelms its enemies by firing coin after coin at them in quick succession.

name: Pyroar
pokedex: The male with the largest mane of fire is the leader of the pride. The females protect the pride's cubs. They viciously threaten any challenger.

name: Gourgeist
pokedex: Eerie cries emanate from its body in the dead of night. The sounds are said to be the wails of spirits who are suffering in the afterlife.

name: Staravia
pokedex: Recognizing their own weakness, they maintain huge flocks. Fierce scuffles break out between various flocks. When alone, a Staravia cries noisily.

name: Magmortar
pokedex: According to what is known, a single pair of male and female Magmortar lives in one volcano. From its arm, it launches fireballs hotter than 3,600ºF.

name: Slowking
pokedex: A combination of toxins and the shock of evolving has increased Shellder's intelligence to the point that Shellder now controls Slowking.

name: Crobat
pokedex: Over the course of evolution, its hind legs turned into wings. By alternately resting its front and rear wings, it can fly all day without having to stop.

name: Appletun
pokedex: Eating a sweet apple caused its evolution. A nectarous scent wafts from its body, luring in the bug Pokémon it preys on.

name: Trubbish
pokedex: It gorges on trash until its stomach is full. Then it belches toxic gas. An unlucky whiff of this gas will put a person in the hospital.

name: Gardevoir
pokedex: It apparently does not feel the pull of gravity because it supports itself with psychic power. It will give its life to protect its Trainer.

name: Fearow
pokedex: Its long neck and elongated beak are ideal for catching prey in soil or water. It deftly moves this extended and skinny beak to pluck prey.

name: Fennekin
pokedex: As it walks, it munches on a twig to fill itself with energy in place of a snack. It intimidates opponents by puffing hot air out of its roomy ears.

name: Heliolisk
pokedex: A single Heliolisk can generate sufficient electricity to power a skyscraper. It can stimulate its muscles with electricity, boosting the strength in its legs.

name: Blastoise
pokedex: The waterspouts that protrude from its shell are highly accurate. Their bullets of water can precisely nail tin cans from a distance of over 160 feet.

name: Floatzel
pokedex: Its flotation sac developed as a result of pursuing aquatic prey. It can double as a rubber raft. It assists in the rescues of drowning people.

name: Simipour
pokedex: It can shoot highly-pressurised water from its tail with enough power to break through a solid concrete wall. It prefers places with clean water.

name: Poliwrath
pokedex: Its highly developed muscles never grow fatigued, however much it exercises. This Pokémon can swim back and forth across the Pacific Ocean without effort.

name: Octillery
pokedex: It ensnares its foe with its suction- cupped tentacles before delivering the finishing blow. If the foe turns out to be too strong, it spews ink to escape.

name: Combusken
pokedex: It lashes out with 10 kicks per second. Its strong fighting instinct compels it to keep up its offensive until the opponent gives up.

name: Swellow
pokedex: A Swellow dives upon prey from far above. It never misses its targets. It takes to the skies in search of lands with a warm climate.

name: Leafeon
pokedex: Its cellular composition is closer to that of a plant than an animal. It uses photosynthesis to produce its energy supply without eating food.

name: Lickilicky
pokedex: The long tongue is always soggy with slobber. The saliva contains a solvent that causes numbness. Getting too close to it will leave you soaked with drool.

name: Mismagius
pokedex: Its cries sound like incantations. Those hearing it are tormented by headaches and hallucinations. It appears where you least expect it.

name: Camerupt
pokedex: A Pokémon that lives in the crater of a volcano. Every 10 years, the volcanoes on its back erupt violently. Research is under way on the cause of eruption.

name: Vespiquen
pokedex: It houses its colony in cells in its body and releases various pheromones to make those grubs do its bidding. There is only one in a colony.

name: Exploud
pokedex: It has sound-generating organs all over its body. It communicates with others by adjusting the tone and volume of the cries it emits.

name: Manectric
pokedex: Because lightning falls in their vicinities, Manectric were thought to have been born from lightning. In battle, they create thunderclouds.

name: Reuniclus
pokedex: They use psychic power to control their arms, which are made of a special liquid. When Reuniclus shake hands, a network forms between their brains.

name: Luxio
pokedex: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch has enough amperage to cause fainting in foes.

name: Magnezone
pokedex: As it zooms through the sky, this Pokémon seems to be receiving signals of unknown origin, while transmitting its own signals of unknown purpose.

name: Mandibuzz
pokedex: They adorn themselves beautifully with bones. This is supposedly an effort to attract males, but no male Mandibuzz have ever been found.

name: Ferrothorn
pokedex: It fights by swinging around its three spiky feelers and shooting spikes. A hit from these steel spikes can reduce a boulder to rubble.

name: Gogoat
pokedex: It can tell how its trainer is feeling by subtle shifts in the grip on its horns. This empathetic sense lets them run as if one being. They inhabit mountainous regions.

name: Stunfisk
pokedex: It conceals itself in the mud of the seashore. Then it waits. When prey touch it, it delivers a jolt of electricity. It smiles when transmitting electricity.

name: Pelipper
pokedex: It skims the tops of waves as it flies. When it spots prey, it uses its large beak to scoop up the victim with water. It protects its eggs in its beak.

name: Chandelure
pokedex: Being consumed in Chandelure's flame burns up the spirit, leaving the body behind. By waving the flames on its arms, it puts its foes into a hypnotic trance.

name: Litten
