pokedex: While grooming itself, it builds up fur inside its stomach. It sets the fur alight and spews fiery attacks, which change based on how it coughs.

name: Meowstic
pokedex: The defensive instinct of the males is strong. It's when they're protecting themselves or their partners that they unleash their full power.

name: Pupitar
pokedex: A Pupitar creates a gas inside its body that it ejects under compression to propel itself like a jet. Its body can withstand a collision with solid steel.

name: Typhlosion
pokedex: It can hide behind a shimmering heat haze that it creates using its intense flames. Typhlosion create blazing explosive blasts that burn everything to cinders.

name: Torterra
pokedex: Some Pokémon are born on a Torterra's back and spend their entire life there. Ancient people imagined that beneath  the ground, a gigantic Torterra dwelled.

name: Haunter
pokedex: If a Haunter beckons you while it is floating in darkness, don't approach it. This Pokémon will try to lick you with its tongue and steal your life away.

name: Meowscarada
pokedex: This Pokémon uses the reflective fur lining its cape to camouflage the stem of its flower, creating the illusion that the flower is floating.

name: Wooper
pokedex: After losing a territorial struggle, Wooper began living on land. The Pokémon changed over time, developing a poisonous film to protect its body.

name: Crawdaunt
pokedex: A brutish Pokémon that loves to battle. A veteran Crawdaunt that has prevailed in hundreds of battles has giant pincers marked with countless scars.

name: Dondozo
pokedex: It treats Tatsugiri like its boss and follows it loyally. Though powerful, Dondozo is apparently not very smart.

name: Cinccino
pokedex: Their white fur feels amazing to touch. Cinccino's body is coated in a special oil that repels dust and helps it deflect attacks, such as punches.

name: Glimmet
pokedex: Glimmet's toxic mineral crystals look just like flower petals. This Pokémon scatters poisonous powder like pollen to protect itself.

name: Inteleon
pokedex: It has many hidden capabilities, such as fingertips that can shoot water and a membrane on its back that it can use to glide through the air.

name: Slowking
pokedex: It undertakes research every day to solve the mysteries of the world. However, it apparently forgets everything if the Shellder on its head comes off.

name: Noctowl
pokedex: It unfailingly catches prey in darkness. Noctowl owe their success to superior vision that allows them to see in minimal light, and to their supple and silent wings.

name: Scyther
pokedex: Its blindingly fast speed adds to the sharpness of its twin forearm scythes. The scythes can slice through thick logs in one wicked stroke.

name: Prinplup
pokedex: Because every Prinplup considers itself to be the most important, they can never form a group. It searches for prey in icy seas.

name: Croagunk
pokedex: Croagunk rarely fights fairly. Inflating its poison sacs, it fills the area with an odd sound and hits flinching opponents with a poison jab.

name: Huntail
pokedex: To withstand the crushing pressure of water deep under the sea, its spine is very thick and sturdy. Its tail, which is shaped like a small fish, has eyes that light up.

name: Coalossal
pokedex: It's usually peaceful, but the vandalism of mines enrages it. Offenders will be incinerated with flames that reach 2,700 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Onix
pokedex: There is a magnet in its brain that prevents an Onix from losing direction while tunneling. As it grows older, its body becomes steadily rounder and smoother.

name: Spidops
pokedex: It clings to branches and ceilings using its threads and moves without a sound. It takes out its prey before the prey even notices it.

name: Electrike
pokedex: It generates electricity using friction from the atmosphere. In seasons with especially arid air, its entire body blazes with violent showers of sparks.

name: Clodsire
pokedex: When attacked, this Pokémon will retaliate by sticking thick spines out from its body. It's a risky move that puts everything on the line.

name: Mawile
pokedex: Its giant jaws are actually steel horns that transformed. It fools foes into complacency with its adorable gestures, then chomps them with its huge jaws.

name: Muk
pokedex: While it's unexpectedly quiet and friendly, if it's not fed any trash for a while,, it will smash its Trainer's furnishings, and eat up the fragments.

name: Yanma
pokedex: It can see 360 degrees without moving its eyes. It is a great flier capable of making sudden stops and turning midair to quickly chase down targeted prey.

name: Hawlucha
pokedex: With its wings, it controls its position in the air. Its proficient fighting skills enable it to keep up with big bruisers like Machamp and Hariyama.

name: Dipplin
pokedex: Dipplin is two creatures in one Pokémon. Its evolution was triggered by a special apple grown only in one place.

name: Torracat
pokedex: At its throat, it bears a bell of fire. The bell rings brightly whenever this Pokémon spits fire. With a single punch, it can bend an iron bar right over.

name: Mr. Rime
pokedex: It's highly skilled at tap-dancing. It waves its cane of ice in time with its graceful movements.

name: Gastly
pokedex: When exposed to a strong wind, a Gastly's gaseous body quickly dwindles away. They cluster under the eaves of houses to escape the ravages of wind.

name: Mareanie
pokedex: It's found crawling on beaches and seafloors. The coral that grows on Corsola's head is as good as a five-star banquet to this Pokémon.

name: Cloyster
pokedex: It swims in the sea by swallowing water, then jetting it out toward the rear. The Cloyster shoots spikes from its shell using the same system.

name: Mimikyu
pokedex: A lonely Pokémon, it hides its terrifying appearance beneath an old rag so it can get closer to people and other Pokémon. Its actual appearance is unknown.

name: Darmanitan
pokedex: On days when blizzards blow through, it comes down to where people live. It stashes food in the snowball on its head, taking it home for later.

name: Caterpie
pokedex: Its voracious appetite compels it to devour leaves bigger than itself without hesitation. It releases a terribly strong odor from its antennae.

name: Sudowoodo
pokedex: It mimics a tree to avoid being attacked by enemies. But since its forelegs remain green throughout the year, it is easily identified as a fake in the winter.

name: Meowth
pokedex: Living with a savage, seafaring people has hardened its body so much that parts of it turned to iron. Darker coins are harder and garner more respect among Meowth.

name: Yanmega
pokedex: This six-legged Pokémon is easily capable of transporting an adult in flight. It is adept at biting apart foes while flying by at high speed.

name: Servine
pokedex: When it gets dirty, its leaves can't be used in photosynthesis, so it always keeps clean. They avoid attacks by sinking into the shadows of thick foliage.

name: Dodrio
pokedex: A peculiar Pokémon species with three heads. It vigorously races across grassy plains even in arid seasons with little rainfall.

name: Froslass
pokedex: When it finds people or Pokémon it likes, it freezes them and takes them to its chilly den, where they become its decorations.

name: Rapidash
pokedex: Little can stand up to its psycho cut. Unleashed from this Pokémon's horn, the move will punch a hole right through a thick metal sheet.

name: Cyclizar
pokedex: It can sprint at over 70 mph while carrying a human. The rider's body heat warms Cyclizar's back and lifts the Pokémon's spirit.

name: Lileep
pokedex: It disguises itself as seaweed by making its tentacles sway. Unsuspecting prey that come too close are swallowed whole. It became extinct 100 million years ago.

name: Cramorant
pokedex: It's so strong that it can knock out some opponents in a single hit, but it also may forget what it's battling midfight.

name: Cufant
pokedex: It digs up the ground with its trunk. It's also very strong, being able to carry loads of over five tons without any problem at all.

name: Medicham
pokedex: Through crushingly harsh yoga training, it gained the power to foretell its foe's actions. It battles with elegant, dance- like movement.

name: Furret
pokedex: A Furret has a very slim build. When under attack, it can squirm through narrow spaces and get away. In spite of its short limbs, it is very nimble and fleet.

name: Pignite
pokedex: The more it eats, the more fuel it has to make the fire in its stomach stronger. When it is angered, the intensity of the flame increases.

name: Infernape
pokedex: Its crown of fire is indicative of its fiery nature. It uses a special kind of martial arts involving all of its limbs to take on any opponent.

name: Bronzong
pokedex: In ages past, this Pokémon was revered as a bringer of rain. One caused a news stir when it was dug up at a construction site after a 2000-year sleep.

name: Lilligant
pokedex: Its well-developed legs are the result of a life spent on mountains covered in deep snow. The scent it exudes from its flower crown heartens those in proximity.

name: Unfezant
pokedex: Males have plumage on their heads. The females' flying abilities surpass those of the males. They will only let themselves feel close to their Trainers.

name: Heatmor
pokedex: It draws in air through its tail, transforms it into fire, and uses it like a tongue. They burn through Durant's steel bodies and consume their insides.

name: Tsareena
pokedex: Its long, striking legs aren't just for show but to be used to kick with skill. In victory, it shows off by kicking the defeated, laughing boisterously.

name: Sealeo
pokedex: Sealeo live in herds on ice floes. Using its powerful flippers, it shatters ice. It dives into the sea to hunt prey five times a day.

name: Relicanth
pokedex: A Pokémon that was once believed to have been extinct. The species has not changed its form for 100 million years. It walks on the seafloor using its pectoral fins.

name: Rapidash
pokedex: It usually canters casually in the fields and plains. But once a Rapidash turns serious, its fiery manes flare and blaze as it gallops its way up to 150 mph.

name: Durant
pokedex: Durant dig nests in mountains. Individuals each play different roles in driving Heatmor, their natural predator, away from their colony.

name: Slowpoke
pokedex: It catches prey by dipping its tail in water at the side of a river. But it often forgets what it is doing and spends entire days just loafing at water's edge.

name: Nidorina
pokedex: When it is with its friends or family, its barbs are tucked away to prevent injury. It appears to become nervous if separated from the others.

name: Misdreavus
pokedex: A Misdreavus frightens people with a creepy, sobbing cry. It apparently uses its red spheres to absorb the fear of foes as its nutrition.

name: Rufflet
pokedex: With its sharp claws, this Pokémon pierces its prey, and then it pecks at them. Although it also consumes berries, it's a carnivore at heart.

name: Volcarona
pokedex: When volcanic ash darkened the atmosphere, it appeared and saved Pokémon from freezing, Volcarona's fire provided a replacement for the sun.

name: Ninetales
pokedex: It has long been said that each of the nine tails embody an enchanted power. A long-lived Ninetales will have fur that shines like gold.

name: Anorith
pokedex: It was resurrected from a fossil using the power of science. It swims by undulating the eight wings at its sides. They were feet that adapted to life in the sea.

name: Cryogonal
pokedex: They are born in snow clouds. When its body temperature goes up, it turns into steam and vanishes. When its temperature lowers, it returns to ice.

name: Buneary
pokedex: You can tell how it feels by the way it rolls its ears. When it's scared, both ears are rolled up. When it senses danger, it perks them up.

name: Seadra
pokedex: The poisonous barbs all over its body are highly valued as ingredients for making traditional herbal medicine. It shows no mercy to anything approaching its nest.

name: Dugtrio
pokedex: Their beautiful, metallic whiskers create a sort of protective helmet on heir heads, and they also function as highly precise sensors.

name: Cyndaquil
pokedex: It flares flames from its back to protect itself. The fire burns vigorously if the Pokémon is angry. When it is tired, it sputters with incomplete combustion.

name: Totodile
pokedex: Despite its small body, Totodile's jaws are very powerful. While it may think it is just playfully nipping, its bite has enough strength to cause serious injury.

name: Grumpig
pokedex: It stores power in the black pearls on its forehead. When it uses psychic power, it performs an odd dance step. Its style of dancing became hugely popular overseas.

name: Orbeetle
pokedex: It's famous for its high level of intelligence, and the large size of its brain is proof that it also possesses immense psychic power.

name: Golduck
pokedex: A Golduck is an adept swimmer. It sometimes joins competitive swimmers in training. It uses psychic powers when its forehead shimmers with light.

name: Shedinja
pokedex: A peculiar Pokémon that floats in air even though its wings remain completely still. The inside of its body is hollow and utterly dark.

name: Fletchling
pokedex: This amiable Pokémon is easy to train. But when battle is joined, it shows its ferocious side. It's merciless to intruders that enter its territory.

name: Tinkaton
pokedex: The hammer tops 220 pounds, yet it gets swung around easily by Tinkaton as it steals whatever it pleases and carries its plunder back home.

name: Farfetch'd
pokedex: It is always seen with a stick from a plant. Apparently, there are good sticks and bad sticks. This Pokémon occasionally fights with others over choice sticks.

name: Piloswine
pokedex: A Piloswine is covered by a thick coat of long hair for enduring freezing cold. It uses its tusks to dig up food that has been buried under ice.

name: Zorua
pokedex: To protect themselves from danger, they hide their true identities by transforming into people and Pokémon. Apparently, it often transforms into a silent child.

name: Jangmo-o
pokedex: It expresses its feelings by smacking its scales. Metallic sounds echo through the tall mountains where Jangmo-o live. They grow little by little battling one another.

name: Liepard
pokedex: Many Trainers are drawn to their beautiful form and fur. These Pokémon vanish and appear unexpectedly. They run silently in the night.

name: Houndstone
pokedex: Houndstone spends most of its time sleeping in graveyards. Among all the dog Pokémon, this one is most loyal to its master.

name: Venonat
pokedex: Its coat of thin, stiff hair that covers its entire body is said to have evolved for protection. Its large eyes never fail to spot even miniscule prey.

name: Venusaur
pokedex: Venusaur's flower is said to take on vivid colors if it gets plenty of nutrition and sunlight. The flower's aroma soothes the emotions of people.

name: Nuzleaf
pokedex: A forest-dwelling Pokémon that is skilled at climbing trees. Its long and pointed nose is its weak point. It loses power if the nose is gripped.

name: Electabuzz
pokedex: When a storm approaches, it competes with others to scale heights that are likely to be stricken by lightning. Some towns use Electabuzz in place of lightning rods.

name: Eiscue
pokedex: It drifted in on the flow of ocean waters from a frigid place. It keeps its head iced constantly to make sure it stays nice and cold.

name: Jolteon
pokedex: Its cells generate weak power that is amplified by its fur's static electricity to drop thunderbolts. The bristling fur is made of electrically charged needles.

name: Grotle
pokedex: A Grotle that lives in the forest is said to have its own secret springwater well.  It carries fellow Pokémon there on  its back.

name: Boldore
pokedex: Its orange crystal is a mass of energy. Just one crystal fragment would provide enough fuel for a hundred dump trucks. When it is healthy, its core sticks out.

name: Flareon
pokedex: Flareon's fluffy fur releases heat into the air so that its body does not get excessively hot. Its body temperature can rise to a maximum of 1,650 degrees F.

name: Nosepass
pokedex: Its body emits a powerful magnetism. It feeds on prey that is pulled in by the force. Its magnetism is stronger in cold seasons.

name: Komala
pokedex: It is born asleep, and it dies asleep. All its movements are apparently no more than the results of it tossing and turning in its dreams.

name: Lurantis
pokedex: It requires a lot of effort to maintain Lurantis's vivid coloring, but some collectors enjoy this work and treat it as their hobby.

name: Raticate
pokedex: A Raticate's sturdy fangs grow steadily. To keep them ground down, it gnaws on rocks and logs. It may even chew on the walls of houses.

name: Galvantula
pokedex: It creates barriers from electrified silk that stun foes. This works as a weapon as well as a defense. While it is immobilized by shock, they leisurely consume it.

name: Marowak
pokedex: A Marowak is the evolved form of a Cubone that has grown tough by overcoming the grief of losing its mother. Its tempered and hardened spirit is not easily broken.

name: Glaceon
pokedex: It can control its body temperature at will. This enables it to freeze the moisture in the atmosphere, creating flurries of diamond dust.

name: Larvitar
pokedex: A Larvitar is born deep under the ground. It must eat its way through the soil above and reach the surface for it to see its parents' faces.

name: Quaxly
pokedex: Its strong legs let it easily swim around in even fast-flowing rivers. It likes to keep things tidy and is prone to overthinking things.

name: Grimer
pokedex: There are a hundred or so of them living in Alola's waste-disposal site. They're all hard workers who eat a lot of trash. Grimer seems to relish any and all kinds of trash.

name: Stoutland
pokedex: Intelligent, good-natured, and valiant, there could be no concern that it would ever attack people. Some parents even trust it to babysit.

name: Doduo
pokedex: Even while eating or sleeping, one of the heads remains always vigilant for any sign of danger. When threatened, it flees at over 60 miles per hour.

name: Magneton
pokedex: It is actually three Magnemite linked by magnetism. It generates powerful radio waves that raise temperatures by 3.6 degrees F within a 3,300-foot radius.

name: Seaking
pokedex: It punches holes in boulders on stream- beds. This is a clever innovation that prevents its eggs from being attacked or washed away by the current.

name: Electrode
pokedex: The tissue on the surface of its body is similar in composition to an Apricorn. When irritated, it lets loose an electric current equal to 20 lightning bolts.

name: Squawkabilly
pokedex: Green-feathered flocks hold the most sway. When they're out searching for food in the mornings and evenings, it gets very noisy.

name: Toedscruel
pokedex: These Pokémon gather into groups and form colonies deep within forests. They absolutely hate it when strangers approach.

name: Mantine
pokedex: On sunny days, schools of Mantine can be seen elegantly leaping over the waves. It is not bothered by the Remoraid that hitches rides.

name: Yamask
pokedex: A clay slab with cursed engravings took possession of a Yamask. The slab is said to be absorbing the Yamask's dark power.

name: Rhyhorn
pokedex: Once it starts running, it doesn't stop. Its tiny brain makes it so stupid that it can't remember why it started running in the first place.

name: Shuppet
pokedex: This Pokémon roams about deep in the night seeking such negative emotions as grudges and envy. It retreats to its nest when the sun begins to rise.

name: Poochyena
pokedex: It savagely threatens foes with bared fangs. It chases after fleeing targets tenaciously. It turns tail and runs, however, if the foe strikes back.

name: Lunatone
pokedex: It becomes very active on the night of a full moon. This Pokémon was first discovered 40 years ago at the site of a meteor strike.

name: Thievul
pokedex: It secretly marks potential targets with a scent. By following the scent, it stalks its targets and steals from them when they least expect it.

name: Ferroseed
pokedex: It absorbs the iron it finds in the rock while clinging to the ceiling of caves. When threatened, it attacks by shooting a barrage of spikes.

name: Bergmite
pokedex: It blocks opponents' attacks with the ice that shields its body. It uses cold air to repair any cracks with new ice. They live in herds on snowy mountains.

name: Archen
pokedex: Said to be the ancestor of all bird Pokémon, Archen itself could not actually fly but moved by hopping from treetop to treetop.

name: Swanna
pokedex: Despite their elegant appearance, they can flap their wings strongly and fly for thousands of miles. The one in the middle is the leader of the flock.

name: Vikavolt
pokedex: It concentrates electrical energy within its large jaws and uses it to zap its foes. It overwhelms bird Pokémon with shocking beams of electrical energy.

name: Geodude
pokedex: Its body is a magnetic stone. Iron sand attach to parts of its body with stronger magnetism. If you carelessly step on one, it will headbutt and shock you in anger.

name: Nidoran♂
pokedex: The male Nidoran has developed muscles that freely move its ears in any direction. Even the slightest sound does not escape this Pokémon's notice.

name: Loudred
pokedex: It positions the round speakers on its head to assail foes with ultrasonic waves at massive volume. It builds power by stomping the ground.

name: Corvisquire
pokedex: Smart enough to use tools in battle, these Pokémon have been seen picking up rocks and flinging them or using ropes to wrap up enemies.

name: Dugtrio
pokedex: Because the triplets originally split from one body, they think exactly alike. They work cooperatively to burrow endlessly through the ground.

name: Clawitzer
pokedex: By expelling water from the nozzle in the back of its enormous claw, it can move at a speed of 60 knots. They launch cannonballs made of water.

name: Pawmo
pokedex: When its group is attacked, Pawmo is the first to leap into battle, defeating enemies with a fighting technique that utilizes electric shocks.

name: Wartortle
pokedex: Its large tail is covered with rich, thick fur that deepens in color with age. The scratches on its shell are evidence of this Pokémon's toughness in battle.

name: Politoed
pokedex: The curled hair on its head proves its status as a king. It is said that the longer and curlier the hair, the more respect it earns from its peers.

name: Pincurchin
pokedex: It feeds on seaweed, using its teeth to scrape it off rocks. Electric current flows from the tips of its spines.

name: Scorbunny
pokedex: A warm-up of running around gets fire energy coursing through this Pokémon's body. Once that happens, it's ready to fight at full power.

name: Marshtomp
pokedex: Its toughened hind legs enable it to stand upright. Because it weakens if its skin dries out, it replenishes fluids by playing in mud.

name: Oinkologne
pokedex: Oinkologne is proud of its fine, glossy skin. It emits a concentrated scent from the tip of its tail.

name: Beldum
pokedex: When Beldum gather in a swarm, they move in perfect unison as if they were but one Pokémon. They communicate with each other using brain waves.

name: Wailmer
pokedex: While this Pokémon usually lives in the sea, it can survive on land, although not too long. It loses vitality if its body becomes dried out.

name: Dartrix
pokedex: A bit of a dandy, it spends its free time preening its wings. Its preoccupation with any dirt on its plumage can leave it unable to battle.

name: Porygon2
pokedex: It was created by humans using the power of science. It has been given artificial intelligence that enables it to learn new gestures and emotions on its own.

name: Cradily
pokedex: It drags its heavy body along the seafloor. It makes its nest in the shallows of warm seas. Cradily can be seen on beaches when the tide goes out.

name: Mr. Mime
pokedex: Its talent is tap-dancing. It can radiate chilliness from the bottoms of its feet to to create a floor of ice, which this Pokémon can kick up to use as a barrier.

name: Snubbull
pokedex: By baring its fangs and making a scary face, it sends smaller Pokémon scurrying in terror. The Snubbull does seem a little sad at making its foes flee.

name: Honedge
pokedex: If anyone dares to grab its hilt, it wraps a blue cloth around that person's arm and drains that person's life energy completely.

name: Leavanny
pokedex: It keeps its eggs warm with heat from fermenting leaves. It also uses leaves to weave warm wrappings for Sewaddle by using the silk secreted from its mouth.

name: Goomy
pokedex: Its source of protection is its slimy, germ-laden mucous membrane. Anyone who touches it will need some thorough hand-washing.

name: Pidgeot
pokedex: This Pokémon has gorgeous, glossy feathers. Many Trainers are so captivated by the beautiful feathers on its head that they choose Pidgeot as their Pokémon.

name: Vaporeon
pokedex: Vaporeon underwent a spontaneous mutation and grew fins and gills that allow them to live underwater. They have the ability to freely control water.

name: Amaura
pokedex: This ancient Pokémon was restored from part of its body that had been frozen in ice for over 100 million years. It lived in a cold land where there were no predators.

name: Horsea
pokedex: By cleverly flicking the fins on its back side to side, it moves in any direction while facing forward. It spits ink to escape if it senses danger.

name: Bellibolt
pokedex: When this Pokémon expands and contracts its wobbly body, the belly- button dynamo in its stomach produces a huge amount of electricity.

name: Chatot
pokedex: It mimics the cries of other Pokémon to trick them into thinking it's one of them. This way they won't attack it. It can also learn and speak human words.

name: Purugly
pokedex: It is a brazen brute that barges its way into another Pokémon's nest and claims it as its own. It binds its body with its tails to make itself look bigger.

name: Girafarig
pokedex: A Girafarig is an herbivore--it eats grass and tree shoots. While it is eating, its tail makes chewing and swallowing motions as if it were also eating.

name: Raichu
pokedex: It uses psychokinesis to control electricity. It focuses psychic energy into its tail and rides it like it's surfing. Another name for this Pokémon is 'hodad'.

name: Morpeko
pokedex: As it eats the seeds stored up in its pocket-like pouches, this Pokémon is not just satisfying its constant hunger. It's also generating electricity.

name: Corphish
pokedex: Once it grips prey with its large pincers, it will never let go, no matter what. It is a hardy Pokémon that can thrive in any environment.

name: Zorua
pokedex: Derives power from resentment, which rises as energy atop its head and takes on the forms of foes. In this way, Zorua vents lingering malice.

name: Ampharos
pokedex: It gives off so much light that it can be seen even from space. People in the old days used its light to send signals back and forth with others far away.

name: Flaaffy
pokedex: Its fleece quality changes to generate strong static electricity with a small amount of wool. The bare, slick parts of its hide are shielded against electricity.

name: Beheeyem
pokedex: It can manipulate an opponent's memory. Apparently, it communicates by flashing its three fingers, but those patterns haven't been decoded.

name: Ponyta
pokedex: Its small horn hides a healing power. This Pokémon will look into your eyes and read the contents of your heart. If it finds evil there, it promptly hides away.

name: Skeledirge
pokedex: Skeledirge's gentle singing soothes the souls of all that hear it. It burns its enemies to a crisp with flames of over 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Litleo
pokedex: They set off on their own from their pride and live by themselves to become stronger. These hot-blooded Pokémon are quick to start a fight.

name: Seel
pokedex: Seel hunt for prey in frigid, ice-covered seas. When it needs to breathe, it punches a hole through the ice with the sharply protruding section of its head.

name: Beautifly
pokedex: Its colorfully patterned wings are its most prominent feature. It flies through flower-covered fields collecting pollen. It attacks ferociously when angered.

name: Ludicolo
pokedex: When it hears festive music, all the cells in its body become stimulated, and it begins moving in rhythm. It does not quail even when it faces a tough opponent.

name: Remoraid
pokedex: A Remoraid uses its abdominal muscles to forcefully expel swallowed water, then shoot down flying prey. When evolution approaches, it travels down rivers.

name: Stunky
pokedex: It protects itself by spraying a nose-curling, stinky fluid from its rear to repel attackers. The stench lingers for 24 hours.

name: Grovyle
pokedex: Leaves grow out of this Pokémon's body. They help obscure a Grovyle from the eyes of its enemies while it is in a thickly overgrown forest.

name: Grimer
pokedex: Born from polluted sludge in the sea, Grimer's favorite food is anything filthy. They feed on wastewater pumped out from factories.

name: Duosion
pokedex: When their brains, now divided in two, are thinking the same thoughts, these Pokémon exhibit their maximized psychic power.

name: Xatu
pokedex: It has the enigmatic power of foreseeing the future. Some people in different lands have long believed that Xatu are emissaries from another world.

name: Shroodle
pokedex: To keep enemies away from its territory, it paints markings around its nest using a poisonous liquid that has an acrid odor.

name: Kilowattrel
pokedex: It uses its throat sac to store electricity generated by its wings. There's hardly any oil in its feathers, so it is a poor swimmer.

name: Shieldon
pokedex: This Pokémon lived in primeval jungles. Few enemies would have been willing to square off against its heavily armored face, so it's thought.

name: Oshawott
pokedex: The scalchop on its stomach isn't just used for battle, it can be used to break open hard berries as well. It is made from the same element as its claws.

name: Oranguru
pokedex: Deep in the jungle, high in the lofty canopy, this Pokémon abides. On rare occasions, it shows up at the beach to match wits with Slowking.

name: Skarmory
pokedex: A Pokémon that has a body and wings of steel. People in the past used feathers fallen from Skarmory to make swords and knives.

name: Arboliva
pokedex: This Pokémon drives back enemies by launching its rich, aromatic oil at them with enough force to smash a boulder.

name: Vibrava
pokedex: It looses ultrasonic waves by rubbing its wings together. Since a Vibrava's wings are still in the process of growing, it can only fly short distances.

name: Chimecho
pokedex: They fly about very actively when the hot season arrives. They communicate among themselves using seven different and distinguishing cries.

name: Frillish
pokedex: If its veil-like arms stun and wrap an opponent, that foe will be dragged five miles below the surface to its lair, never to return.

name: Tatsugiri
pokedex: This is a small dragon Pokémon. It lives inside the mouth of Dondozo to protect itself from enemies on the outside.

name: Buizel
pokedex: It inflates its flotation sac, keeping its face above water in order to watch for prey movement. It swims by rotating its two tails like a screw.

name: Magcargo
pokedex: The shell on its back is made of hardened magma. Tens of thousands of years spent living in volcanic craters have turned Magcargo's bodies into magma.

name: Torkoal
pokedex: It battles using energy it gets from burning coal. When loosing smoke from its nostrils, it lets off a sound that is similar to a locomotive's horn.

name: Wugtrio
pokedex: A variety of fish Pokémon, Wugtrio was once considered to be a regional form of Dugtrio.

name: Whiscash
pokedex: Mysteriously, it can foretell earthquakes. In the daytime, it sleeps in mud at the bottom of a pond. When it awakens, it continually feeds throughout the night.

name: Raticate
pokedex: It forms a group of Rattata, which it  assumes command of. Each group has its own territory, and disputes over food happen often.

name: Treecko
pokedex: It makes its nest in a giant tree in the forest. It ferociously guards against anything nearing its territory. It is said to be the protector of the forest's trees.

name: Sentret
pokedex: They take turns standing guard when it is time to sleep. The sentry awakens the others if it senses danger. If one becomes separated, it turns sleepless with fear.

name: Spinarak
pokedex: The web it spins can be considered its second nervous system. It is said that a Spinarak determines its prey by the tiny vibrations it feels through the web.

name: Pineco
pokedex: A Pineco hangs from a tree branch and waits for prey. While eating, if it is disturbed by someone shaking its tree, it falls on the ground and suddenly explodes.

name: Varoom
pokedex: The steel section is Varoom's actual body. This Pokémon clings to rocks and converts the minerals within into energy to fuel its activities.

name: Yungoos
pokedex: With its sharp fangs, it will bite anything. It wanders around in a never-ending search for food. At dusk, it collapses and falls asleep on the spot.

name: Araquanid
pokedex: Despite what its appearance suggests, it cares for others. If it finds vulnerable, weak Pokémon, it protectively brings them into its water bubble.

name: Dachsbun
pokedex: The pleasant aroma that emanates from this Pokémon's body helps wheat grow, so Dachsbun has been treasured by farming villages.

name: Dubwool
pokedex: Weave a carpet from its springy wool, and you end up with something closer to a trampoline. You'll start to bounce the moment you set foot on it.

name: Ivysaur
pokedex: To support its bulb, Ivysaur's legs grow sturdy. If it spends more time lying in the sunlight, the bud will soon bloom into a large flower.

name: Lumineon
pokedex: Lumineon swimming in the darkness of the deep sea look like stars shining in the night sky. It competes for food with Lanturn.

name: Bulbasaur
pokedex: Bulbasaur can be seen napping in bright sunlight. There is a seed on its back. By soaking up the sun's rays, the seed grows progressively larger.

name: Accelgor
pokedex: When its body dries out, it weakens. So, to prevent dehydration, it wraps itself in layers of thin membrane. It is very light and fights with ninja-like movements.

name: Inkay
pokedex: It flashes the light-emitting spots on its body, which drains its opponent's will to fight. It takes the opportunity to scuttle away and hide.

name: Poliwhirl
pokedex: Its body surface is always wet and slick with an oily fluid. Because of this greasy covering, it can easily slip and slide out of the clutches of any enemy in battle.

name: Ninetales
pokedex: While it will guide travelers who get lost on a snowy mountain down to the mountain's base, it won't forgive anyone who harms nature.

name: Kricketune
pokedex: It signals its emotions with its melodies. There is a village that hosts a contest based on the amazingly variable cries of this Pokémon.

name: Golett
pokedex: These Pokémon are thought to have been created by the science of an ancient and mysterious civilization. It's been active for thousands of years.

name: Carbink
pokedex: Born from the high temperatures and pressures deep underground, it defends itself by firing beams from the jewel part of its body.

name: Minior
pokedex: Originally making its home in the ozone layer, it hurtles to the ground when the shell encasing its body grows too heavy. It was born from mutated nanoparticles.

name: Oricorio
pokedex: It wins the hearts of its enemies with its passionate dancing and then uses the opening it creates to burn them up with blazing flames.

name: Tyrogue
pokedex: Tyrogue become stressed out if they do not get to train every day. When raising this Pokémon, the Trainer must establish a regular training schedule.

name: Thwackey
pokedex: The faster a Thwackey can beat out a rhythm with its two sticks, the more respect it wins from its peers.

name: Aron
pokedex: A Pokémon that is clad in steel armor. A new suit of armor is made when it evolves. The old, discarded armor is salvaged as metal for making iron products.

name: Snorlax
pokedex: Snorlax's typical day consists of nothing more than eating and sleeping. It is such a docile Pokémon that there are children who use its big belly as a place to play.

name: Armarouge
pokedex: Armarouge evolved through the use of a set of armor that belonged to a distinguished warrior. This Pokémon is incredibly loyal.

name: Lickitung
pokedex: Whenever it sees something unfamiliar, it always licks the object because it memorizes things by texture and taste. It is somewhat put off by sour things.

name: Larvesta
pokedex: This Pokémon was believed to have been born from the sun. It spews fire from its horns and encases itself in a cocoon of fire when it evolves.

name: Quaxwell
pokedex: The hardworking Quaxwell observes people and Pokémon from various regions and incorporates their movements into its own dance routines.

name: Bellsprout
pokedex: A Bellsprout's thin and flexible body lets it bend and sway to avoid any attack, however strong it may be. From its mouth, it leaks a fluid that melts even iron.

name: Crabrawler
pokedex: While guarding its weak points with its pincers, it looks for an opening and unleashes punches. When it loses, it foams at the mouth and faints.

name: Parasect
pokedex: Parasect are known to infest the roots of large trees en masse and drain nutrients. When an infested tree dies, they move onto another tree all at once.

name: Simisear
pokedex: It loves sweets because they become energy for the fire burning inside its body. It scatters embers from its head and tail to sear its opponents.

name: Vivillon
pokedex: It lives hidden within thicket shadows. When predators attack, it quickly bristles the fur covering its body in an effort to threaten them.

name: Charmander
pokedex: The flame that burns at the tip of its tail is an indication of its emotions. The flame wavers when Charmander is happy, and blazes when it is enraged.

name: Mr. Mime
pokedex: A Mr. Mime is a master of pantomime. It can convince others that something unseeable actually exists. Once believed, the imaginary object does become real.

name: Whirlipede
pokedex: Storing energy for evolution, it sits. But when attacked, it spins its body at high speed like a wheel and then crashes furiously into its opponent.

name: Sinistea
pokedex: This Pokémon is said to have been born when a lonely spirit possessed a cold, leftover cup of tea.

name: Sinistcha
pokedex: It pretends to be tea, trying to fool people into drinking it so it can drain their life-force. Its ruse is generally unsuccessful.

name: Tadbulb
pokedex: Tadbulb shakes its tail to generate electricity. If it senses danger, it will make its head blink on and off to alert its allies.

name: Gloom
pokedex: A horribly noxious honey drools from its mouth. One whiff of the honey can result in memory loss. Some fans are said to enjoy this overwhelming stink, however.

name: Machop
pokedex: It continually undertakes strenuous training to master all forms of martial arts. Its strength lets it easily hoist a sumo wrestler onto its shoulders.

name: Meditite
pokedex: It continually meditates for hours every day. As a result of rigorous and dedicated yoga training, it has tempered its spiritual power so much it can fly.

name: Phantump
pokedex: According to legend, medicine to cure any illness can be made by plucking the green leaves on its head, brewing them, and boiling down the liquid.

name: Dewott
pokedex: Strict training and disclipine leads it to master its flowing double-scalchop technique. Scalchop techniques differ from one Dewott to another.

name: Chinchou
pokedex: When it senses danger, it discharges positive and negative electricity from its two antennae. It lives in depths beyond sunlight's reach.

name: Wattrel
pokedex: When its wings catch the wind, the bones within produce electricity. This Pokémon dives into the ocean, catching prey by electrocuting them.

name: Ninjask
pokedex: Because it darts about vigorously at high speed, it is very difficult to see. Hearing its distinctive cries for too long induces a headache.

name: Charcadet
pokedex: Burnt charcoal came to life and became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit, Charcadet will battle even tough opponents.

name: Cubchoo
pokedex: Its nose is always running. Their snot is a barometer of health. When healthy, their snot is sticky and the power of their ice moves increases.

name: Ribombee
pokedex: Ribombee rolls up pollen into puffs. It makes many different varieties, some used as food and others used in battle. They are sometimes sold as supplements.

name: Gothita
pokedex: They intently observe both Trainers and Pokémon. Apparently, Gothita are looking at something that only they can see. Their ribbonlike feelers increase their power.

name: Tentacool
pokedex: Its body is almost entirely composed of water. It ensnares its foe with its two long tentacles, then stabs with the poison stingers at their tips.

name: Vanillish
pokedex: Vanillish has existed since the Ice Age. It controls particles of ice, freezes its opponents, and then shatters them with a headbutt.

name: Rattata
pokedex: A Rattata is cautious in the extreme. Even while it is asleep, it constantly moves its ears and listens for danger. It will make its nest anywhere.

name: Crocalor
pokedex: The combination of Crocalor's fire energy and overflowing vitality has caused an egg-shaped fireball to appear on the Pokémon's head.

name: Piplup
pokedex: A poor walker, it often falls down. However, its strong pride makes it puff up its chest without a care. It's difficult to bond with since it won't listen to its Trainer.

name: Hattrem
pokedex: No matter who you are, if you bring strong emotions near this Pokémon, it will silence you violently.

name: Braixen
pokedex: Braixen has a twig stuck in its tail. When the twig is plucked from its tail, friction sets the twig alight. The flame is used to send signals to its allies.

name: Geodude
pokedex: It climbs mountain paths using only the power of its arms. Because they look just like boulders lining paths, hikers may step on them without noticing.

name: Lanturn
pokedex: The light-emitting orbs on its back are very bright. They are formed from a part of its dorsal fin. This Pokémon illuminates the inky darkness of deep seas.

name: Kirlia
pokedex: A Kirlia has the psychic power to create  a rip in the dimensions and see into the future. It is said to dance with pleasure on sunny mornings.

name: Palafin
pokedex: This Pokémon changes its appearance if it hears its allies calling for help. Palafin will never show anybody its moment of transformation.

name: Ambipom
pokedex: They live on large trees. Split into two, the tails are so adept at handling and doing things, Ambipom rarely uses its hands now.

name: Sawsbuck
pokedex: Some people call Sawsbuck the harbingers of spring because the plants growing on its horns change according to the season. The leader possesses magnificent horns.

name: Growlithe
pokedex: Its superb sense of smell ensures that this Pokémon won't forget any scent, no matter what. It uses its sense of smell to detect the emotions of others.

name: Gimmighoul
pokedex: It lives inside an old treasure chest. Sometimes it gets left in shop corners since no one realizes it's actually a Pokémon.

name: Morgrem
pokedex: When it gets down on all fours as if to beg for forgiveness, it's trying to lure opponents in so that it can stab them with its spear-like hair.

name: Mudbray
pokedex: The mud stuck to Mudbray's hooves enhances its grip and its powerful running gait. Eating dirt, making mud, and playing in the mire form its daily routine.

name: Gothorita
pokedex: Starlight is the source of their power. They use hypnosis to control people and Pokémon. Tales of Gothorita leading them astray are told in every corner.

name: Alomomola
pokedex: When they find a wounded Pokémon, they embrace it and bring it to shore. The special membrane enveloping Alomomola has the ability to heal wounds.

name: Golbat
pokedex: Its fangs easily puncture even thick animal hide. It loves to feast on the blood of people and Pokémon. It flits about in darkness and strikes from behind.

name: Togedemaru
pokedex: The spiny fur on its back is normally at rest. When this Pokémon becomes agitated, its fur stands on end and stabs into its attackers.

name: Silicobra
pokedex: As it digs, it swallows sand and stores it in its neck pouch. The pouch can hold more than 17 pounds of sand.

name: Magby
pokedex: If a Magby is spouting yellow flames from its mouth, it is in good health. When it is fatigued, black smoke will be mixed in with the flames.

name: Sandygast
pokedex: It takes control of anyone who puts a hand in its mouth, to add to the pile of its sand-mound body. This Pokémon embodies the grudges of the departed.

name: Tangela
pokedex: Its vines snap off easily and painlessly if they are grabbed, allowing it to make a quick getaway. The lost vines are replaced by new growth the very next day.

name: Lapras
pokedex: People have driven Lapras almost to the point of extinction. In the evenings, it is said to sing plaintively as it seeks what few others of its kind still remain.

name: Mudkip
pokedex: On land, it can powerfully lift large boulders by planting its four feet and heaving. It sleeps by burying itself in soil at the water's edge.

name: Castform
pokedex: It alters its form depending on the weather. Changes in the climate such as the temperature and humidity appear to affect its cellular structure.

name: Weepinbell
pokedex: At night, a Weepinbell hangs on to a tree branch with its hooked rear and sleeps. If it moves around in its sleep, it may wake up to find itself on the ground.

name: Corsola
pokedex: Sudden climate change wiped out this ancient kind of Corsola. With its branches, it absorbs others' life-force. It curses those unaware that kick it by accident.

name: Slurpuff
pokedex: Slurpuff can distinguish even the faintest of scents. It puts its sensitive sense of smell to use by helping pastry chefs in their work.

name: Breloom
pokedex: It scatters spores from holes in the cap on its head. It loves warm and humid climates. It feeds on trees and plants in fields and forests.

name: Swoobat
pokedex: Anyone who comes into contact with the ultrasonic waves emitted by a courting male experiences a positive mood shift.

name: Poltchageist
pokedex: Supposedly, the regrets of a tea ceremony master who died before perfecting his craft lingered in some matcha and became a Pokémon.

name: Kabuto
pokedex: It is a Pokémon that has been regenerated from a fossil. However, in rare cases, living examples have been discovered. Kabuto have not changed for 300 million years.

name: Phanpy
pokedex: Phanpy's big ears serve as broad fans. When it becomes hot, it flaps the ears busily to cool down. Even the young are very strong.

name: Flittle
pokedex: Flittle's toes levitate about half an inch above the ground because of the psychic power emitted from the frills on the Pokémon's belly.

name: Munchlax
pokedex: When it finds something that looks like it might be edible, it goes right ahead and swallows it whole. That's why it gets fatter day by day.

name: Kadabra
pokedex: It is rumored that a boy with psychic abilities suddenly transformed into Kadabra while he was assisting research into extrasensory powers.

name: Clamperl
pokedex: A Clamperl slams its shell closed on prey to prevent escape. The pearl it creates upon evolution is said to be infused with a mysterious energy.

name: Frosmoth
pokedex: Icy scales fall from its wings like snow as it flies over fields and mountains. The temperature of its wings is less than -290 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Porygon
pokedex: It is capable of reverting itself entirely back to program data in order to enter cyberspace. A Porygon is copy- protected so it cannot be duplicated.

name: Dewpider
pokedex: It crawls onto the land in search of food. When it comes across enemies or potential prey, this Pokémon smashes its water-bubble-covered head into them.

name: Wigglytuff
pokedex: Its fur is the ultimate in luxuriousness. Sleeping alongside a Wigglytuff is simply divine. Its body expands seemingly without end when it inhales.

name: Monferno
pokedex: It carefully controls the intensity of the flame on its tail, so as to keep its foes at an adequate distance. Its fiery tail is but one weapon.

name: Tranquill
pokedex: No matter where in the world it goes, it knows where its nest is, so it can always return to its Trainer's location regardless of the distance.

name: Bellossom
pokedex: Its flower petals deepen in color through exposure to sunlight. When cloudy weather persists, it does a dance that is thought to be a ritual for summoning the sun.

name: Rabsca
pokedex: The body that supports the ball barely moves. Therefore, it is thought that the true body of this Pokémon is actually inside the ball.

name: Growlithe
pokedex: They patrol their territory in pairs. It's believed the igneous rock components in the fur of this species are the result of volcanic activity in its habitat.

name: Togekiss
pokedex: As everyone knows, it visits peaceful regions, bringing them gifts of kindness and sweet blessings. It will never appear where there is strife.

name: Tropius
pokedex: It flies by flapping its broad leaves. The bunch of fruit that grows around its neck is deliciously sweet. In the spring, it scatters pollen from its neck.

name: Maushold
pokedex: The little one just appeared one day. They all live together like a family, but the relationship between the three is still unclear.

name: Tinkatuff
pokedex: These Pokémon make their homes in piles of scrap metal. They test the strength of each other's hammers by smashing them together.

name: Ponyta
pokedex: A Ponyta is very weak at birth. It can barely stand up. Its legs become stronger as it stumbles and falls while trying to keep up with its parent.

name: Turtwig
pokedex: The shell on its back is made of soil.  On a very healthy Turtwig, the shell  should feel moist. The leaf on its head wilts if it is thirsty.

name: Shinx
pokedex: It rapidly contracts and relaxes its muscles to generate electricity. Its body shines if endangered. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.

name: Drilbur
pokedex: It can dig through the ground at a speed of 30 mph by spinning its body. It could give a car running aboveground a good race.

name: Wooper
pokedex: Wooper usually live in water but come out onto land seeking food occasionally. On land, they coat their bodies with a gooey, toxic film.

name: Cetoddle
pokedex: This species left the ocean and began living on land a very long time ago. It seems to be closely related to Wailmer.

name: Drizzile
pokedex: A clever combatant, this Pokémon battles using water balloons created with moisture secreted from its palms.

name: Squirtle
pokedex: Its shell is not just for protection. Its rounded shape and the grooves on its surface minimize resistance in water, enabling Squirtle to swim at high speeds.

name: Vullaby
pokedex: It can't fly yet and must wait until its wings have developed more. They guard their posteriors with bones that were gathered by Mandibuzz.

name: Greedent
pokedex: It stashes berries in its tail--so many berries that they fall out constantly. But this Pokémon is a bit slow-witted, so it doesn't notice the loss.

name: Delcatty
pokedex: Rather than keeping a permanent lair, it habitually seeks comfortable spots and sleeps there. It is nocturnal and becomes active at dusk.

name: Pidgeotto
pokedex: This Pokémon flies around, patrolling its large territory. If its living space is violated, it shows no mercy in thoroughly punishing the foe with its sharp claws.

name: Kecleon
pokedex: A Pokémon that has the ability to alter its body colors to match its surroundings. A Kecleon reverts to its original colors if it is startled.

name: Frogadier
pokedex: It can throw bubble-covered pebbles with precise control, hitting empty cans up to a hundred feet away. Frogadier's swiftness is unparalleled.

name: Graveler
pokedex: When two Graveler smash each other over dravite, their favorite food, they cause flashes of light and booming noises. People call them “fireworks of the earth.”

name: Butterfree
pokedex: It has a superior ability to search for delicious honey from flowers. It can seek, extract, and carry honey from flowers blooming over six miles away.

name: Dewgong
pokedex: It loves to snooze on bitterly cold ice. The sight of this Pokémon sleeping on a glacier was mistakenly thought to be a mermaid by a mariner long ago.

name: Slowpoke
pokedex: Although it is normally zoned out, its expression abruptly sharpens on occasion. The cause seems to lie in Slowpoke's diet, which also give their tails a spicy flavor.

name: Delibird
pokedex: It carries food bundled up in its tail. There was a famous explorer who managed to scale Mt. Everest thanks to a Delibird sharing its food.

name: Aromatisse
pokedex: Its scent is so overpowering that, unless a Trainer happens to really enjoy the smell, he or she will have a hard time walking alongside it.

name: Eldegoss
pokedex: The seeds attached to its cotton fluff are full of nutrients. It spreads them on the wind so that plants and other Pokémon can benefit from them.

name: Roselia
pokedex: A Roselia that drinks nutritionally rich springwater blooms with lovely flowers. The fragrance of its flowers has the effect of making its foes careless.

name: Naclstack
pokedex: It compresses rock salt inside its body and shoots out hardened salt pellets with enough force to perforate an iron sheet.

name: Trapinch
pokedex: Its big jaws crunch through boulders. Because its head is so big, it has a hard time getting back upright if it tips over onto its back.

name: Foongus
pokedex: It lures Pokémon in with its pattern that looks just like a Poké Ball, then releases its poison spores. Why it resembles a Poké Ball is unknown.

name: Ledian
pokedex: It is said that in lands with clean air, where the stars fill the sky, there live many Ledian. For good reason, they use the light of the stars as energy.

name: Cherrim
pokedex: It's motionless, save for the occasional quiver. A rich array of Pokémon can be found gathered around it, drawn by the scent exuded from Cherrim's folded petals.

name: Lilligant
pokedex: Even veteran Trainers face a challenge in getting its beautiful flower to bloom. It withers away if a trainer does not take good care of it.

name: Litwick
pokedex: While Litwick shines a light and pretends to be a guide, it absorbs the life force of any who follow it, which becomes the fuel that it burns.

name: Klink
pokedex: Two bodies comprise a fixed pair. The two minigears that mesh together are predetermined. Each will rebound from other minigears without meshing.

name: Volbeat
pokedex: With their taillights lit, Volbeat fly in a swarm, drawing geometric designs in the night sky. They move their nests if their pond water becomes dirty.

name: Binacle
pokedex: They stretch and then contract, yanking their rocks along with them in bold hops. They eat seaweed that washes up on the shoreline.

name: Krabby
pokedex: Krabby live in holes dug into beaches. On sandy shores with little in the way of food, they can be seen squabbling with each other over territory.

name: Sandshrew
pokedex: When it curls up in a ball, it can make any attack bounce off harmlessly. Its hide has turned tough and solid as a result of living in the desert.

name: Aipom
pokedex: Its tail ends with a dexterous, handlike appendage. However, because it uses the tail so much, Aipom's real hands have become rather clumsy.

name: Klefki
pokedex: These key collectors threaten any attackers by fiercely jingling their keys at them. It will sneak into people's homes to steal their keys.

name: Elekid
pokedex: If it touches metal and discharges the electricity it has stored in its body, an Elekid begins swinging its arms in circles to recharge itself.

name: Maractus
pokedex: Arid regions are their habitat. When it moves rhythmically, it makes a sound similar to maracas, making the surprised Pokémon flee.

name: Jynx
pokedex: A Jynx sashays rhythmically as if it were dancing. Its motions are so bouncingly alluring, people seeing it are compelled to shake their hips without noticing.

name: Wobbuffet
pokedex: Usually docile, a Wobbuffet strikes back ferociously if its black tail is attacked. It makes its lair in caves where it waits for nightfall.

name: Noibat
pokedex: They live in pitch-black caves. Even a robust wrestler will become dizzy and unable to stand when exposed to its 200,000-hertz ultrasonic waves.

name: Rookidee
pokedex: It will bravely challenge any opponent, no matter how powerful. This Pokémon benefits from every battle--even a defeat increases its strength a bit.

name: Smeargle
pokedex: A Smeargle marks its territory using a fluid that leaks out from the tip of its tail. About 5,000 different marks left by this Pokémon have been found.

name: Toxel
pokedex: It stores poison in an internal poison sac and secretes that poison through its skin. If you touch this Pokémon, a tingling sensation follows.

name: Dunsparce
pokedex: Its drill-tipped tail is used to burrow into the ground backwards. This Pokémon is known to make its nest in complex shapes deep under the ground.

name: Timburr
pokedex: These Pokémon appear at building sites and help out with construction. They always carry squared logs. As they grow, they carry bigger logs.

name: Tirtouga
pokedex: Reputed to be the ancestor of most turtle Pokémon, it lived in warm seas about a hundred million years ago. It was restored from a fossil.

name: Primarina
pokedex: It controls its water balloons with song. The melody is learned from others of its kind and is passed down from one generation to the next.

name: Fletchinder
pokedex: From its beak, it expels embers that set the tall grass on fire. Then it pounces on any bewildered Pokémon that pop out of the grass.

name: Kakuna
pokedex: It remains virtually immobile while it clings to a tree. However, on the inside, it busily prepares for evolution. This is evident from how hot its shell becomes.

name: Wormadam
pokedex: Its appearance changes depending on where Burmy evolved. The materials on hand become a part of its body. The cloak is never shed.

name: Espurr
pokedex: It has enough psychic energy to blast everything within 300 feet of itself. The organ that emits its intense psychic power is sheltered by its ears.

name: Helioptile
pokedex: They make their home in deserts. They can generate their own energy from basking in the sun, so eating food is not a requirement.

name: Bayleef
pokedex: A Bayleef's neck is ringed by curled-up leaves. Inside each leaf is a small tree shoot. The fragrance of this shoot makes people peppy.

name: Applin
pokedex: It spends its entire life inside an apple. It hides from its natural enemies, bird Pokémon, by pretending it's just an apple and nothing more.

name: Corsola
pokedex: Corsola live in warm southern seas. If the sea becomes polluted, the beautiful coral stalks become discolored and crumble away in tatters.

name: Pyukumuku
pokedex: It lives in shallow seas, such as areas near a beach. The sticky mucous that covers their bodies can be used to soothe sunburned skin. How convenient!

name: Brionne
pokedex: It cares deeply for its companions. When its Trainer is feeling down, it performs a cheery dance with a sequence of water balloons to try and help.

name: Spearow
pokedex: Its loud cry can be heard over half a mile away. If its high, keening cry is heard echoing all around, it is a sign that they are warning each other of danger.

name: Smoochum
pokedex: It actively runs about, but also falls often. Whenever it falls, it will check its reflection on a lake's surface to make sure its face hasn't become dirty.

name: Torchic
pokedex: If attacked, it strikes back by spitting balls of fire it forms in its stomach. A Torchic dislikes darkness because it can't see its surroundings.

name: Fuecoco
pokedex: Its flame sac is small, so energy is always leaking out. This energy is released from the dent atop Fuecoco's head and flickers to and fro.

name: Musharna
pokedex: The mist emanating from their foreheads is packed with the dreams of people and Pokémon. It changes into different colors depending on the dream that was eaten.

name: Pikachu
pokedex: It stores electricity in the electric sacs on its cheeks. When it releases pent-up energy in a burst, the electric power is equal to a lightning bolt.

name: Hippopotas
pokedex: Hippopotas shuts its nostrils tight when travelling through sand. Instead of perspiration, it expels grains of sand from its body.

name: Palpitoad
pokedex: It lives in the water and on land. When they vibrate the bumps on their heads, they can make waves in water or earthquake-like vibrations on land.

name: Azumarill
pokedex: It lives in water virtually all day long. Its body color and pattern act as camouflage that makes it tough for enemies to spot in water.

name: Pichu
pokedex: It is still inept at retaining electricity. When it is startled, it discharges power accidentally. It gets better at holding power as it grows older.

name: Togetic
pokedex: It is said to be a Pokémon that brings good fortune. When it spots someone who is pure of heart, a Togetic appears and shares its happiness with that person.

name: Jumpluff
pokedex: Jumpluff ride warm southern winds to cross the sea and fly to foreign lands. This Pokémon lands when it encounters cold air while it is floating.

name: Gulpin
pokedex: This Pokémon's stomach fluid can even digest scrap iron. In one gulp, it can swallow something that is as large as itself.

name: Voltorb
pokedex: It bears an uncanny and unexplained resemblance to a Poké Ball. Because it explodes at the slightest shock, even veteran Trainers treat it with caution.

name: Bramblin
pokedex: A soul unable to move on to the afterlife was blown around by the wind until it got tangled up with dried grass and became a Pokémon.

name: Watchog
pokedex: Using luminescent matter, it makes its eyes and body glow and stuns attacking opponents. Keen eyesight lets them see in the dark.

name: Espeon
pokedex: An Espeon is extremely loyal to any Trainer it considers to be worthy. It is said to have developed precognitive powers to protect its Trainer from harm.

name: Illumise
pokedex: A nocturnal Pokémon that becomes active upon nightfall. It leads a Volbeat swarm to draw patterns in the night sky. Over 200 different patterns have been confirmed.

name: Popplio
pokedex: This Pokémon snorts body fluids from its nose, blowing balloons to smash into its foes. It practices diligently so it can learn to make big bubbles.

name: Carkol
pokedex: It forms coal inside its body. Coal dropped by this Pokémon once helped fuel the lives of people in the Galar region.

name: Pikipek
pokedex: This Pokémon feeds on berries, whose leftover seeds become the ammunition for the attacks it fires off from its mouth. It uses holes in trees for nesting.

name: Sunflora
pokedex: Sunflora convert solar energy into nutrition. They are highly active in the warm daytime but suddenly stop moving as soon as the sun sets.

name: Teddiursa
pokedex: It licks its palms that are sweetened by being soaked in honey. A Teddiursa makes its own honey by blending fruits and pollen collected by Beedrill.

name: Grookey
pokedex: When it uses its special stick to strike up a beat, the sound waves produced carry revitalizing energy to the plants and flowers in the area.

name: Makuhita
pokedex: It loves to toughen up its body above all else. If you hear quaking rumbles in a cave, it is the sound of Makuhita undertaking strenuous training.

name: Rotom
pokedex: Its body is composed of plasma and loves to surprise others. One boy's invention led to the development of many machines that can use of Rotom's unique capabilities.

name: Sobble
pokedex: When scared, this Pokémon cries. Its tears pack the chemical punch of 100 onions, and attackers won't be able to resist weeping.

name: Floragato
pokedex: Floragato deftly wields the vine hidden beneath its long fur, slamming the hard flower bud against its opponents.

name: Sprigatito
pokedex: The sweet scent its body gives off mesmerizes those around it. The scent grows stronger when this Pokémon is in the sun.

name: Magnemite
pokedex: The units at its sides are extremely powerful magnets. They generate enough magnetism to draw in iron objects from over 300 feet away.

name: Chewtle
pokedex: Apparently the itch of its teething impels it to snap its jaws at anything in front of it.

name: Drifloon
pokedex: Because of the way it floats aimlessly, an old folktale calls it a “Signpost for Wandering Spirits.” Children holding them sometimes vanish.

name: Slugma
pokedex: It is a species of Pokémon that lives in volcanic areas. If its body cools, its skin hardens and immobilizes it. To avoid that, it sleeps near magma.

name: Snorunt
pokedex: They tend to move about in groups of around five Snorunt. In snowy regions, it is said that when they are seen late at night, snowfall will arrive by morning.

name: Meowth
pokedex: It's accustomed to luxury because it used to live with Alolan royalty. Highly smart and proud, it's famously difficult to handle, but that also makes it popular.

name: Spewpa
pokedex: It lives hidden within thicket shadows. When predators attack, it quickly bristles the fur covering its body in an effort to threaten them.

name: Riolu
pokedex: It can discern the physical and emotional states of people, Pokémon, and other natural things from the shape of their aura waves.

name: Roggenrola
pokedex: The hexagonal cavity is its ear. It walks in the direction of sounds it hears, but if the sounds cease, it panics and topples over.

name: Shuckle
pokedex: A Shuckle hides under rocks, keeping its body concealed inside its shell while eating stored berries. The berries mix with its body fluids to become a juice.

name: Poliwag
pokedex: It is possible to see this Pokémon's spiral innards right through its thin skin. However, the skin is also very flexible. Even sharp fangs bounce right off it.

name: Magikarp
pokedex: Its swimming muscles are weak, so it is easily washed away by currents. In places where water pools, you can see many Magikarp deposited there by the flow.

name: Clefable
pokedex: A Clefable uses its wings to skip lightly  as if it were flying. Its bouncy step lets it even walk on water. On quiet, moonlit nights, it strolls on lakes.

name: Ditto
pokedex: A Ditto rearranges its cell structure to transform itself. However, if it tries to change based on its memory, it will get details wrong.

name: Pumpkaboo
pokedex: The light that streams out from the holes in the pumpkin can hypnotize and control the people and Pokémon that see it.

name: Wishiwashi
pokedex: Individually, they're incredibly weak. It's by gathering up into schools that they're able to confront opponents.

name: Persian
pokedex: A Persian's six bold whiskers sense air movements to determine what is in its vicinity. It becomes docile if grabbed by the whiskers.

name: Voltorb
pokedex: It resembles an ancient Poké Ball design. When excited, it discharges the electric current it has stored in its belly, then lets out a great, uproarious laugh.

name: Yamask
pokedex: These Pokémon arose from the spirits of people interred in graves in past ages. Each of them carries a mask that used to be its face when it was human.

name: Bronzor
pokedex: Implements shaped like it were discovered in ancient tombs. There are researchers who believe this Pokémon reflected like a mirror in the distant past.

name: Dwebble
pokedex: It makes a hole in a stone of a suitable size. If that rock breaks, the Pokémon remains agitated until it locates a replacement.

name: Eevee
pokedex: An Eevee has an unstable genetic makeup that suddenly mutates due to its environment. Radiation from various Stones causes this Pokémon to evolve.

name: Cascoon
pokedex: To avoid detection by its enemies, it hides motionlessly beneath large leaves and in the gaps of branches. It also attaches dead leaves to its body for camouflage.

name: Quilladin
pokedex: They strengthen the sturdy shell covering their bodies by running into one another. They are very kind and won't start fights, but will counterattack with sharp quills.

name: Nymble
pokedex: It has its third set of legs folded up. When it's in a tough spot, this Pokémon jumps over 30 feet using the strength of its legs.

name: Vigoroth
pokedex: It can't keep still because its blood boils with energy. It runs through the fields and mountains all day to calm itself. If it doesn't, it can't sleep at night.

name: Drowzee
pokedex: If your nose becomes itchy while you are sleeping, it's a sure sign that a Drowzee is standing above your pillow and trying to eat your dream through your nostrils.

name: Tinkatink
pokedex: This Pokémon pounds iron scraps together to make a hammer. It will remake the hammer again and again until it's satisfied with the result.

name: Clobbopus
pokedex: It's very curious, but its means of investigating things is to try to punch them with its tentacles. The search for food is what brings it onto land.

name: Blipbug
pokedex: A constant collector of information, this Pokémon is very smart. Very strong is what it isn't.

name: Darumaka
pokedex: The colder they get, the more energetic they are. They freeze their breath to make snowballs, using them as ammo for playful snowball fights.

name: Chimchar
pokedex: Its fiery rear end is fueled by gas made in its belly. Before going to sleep, Chimchar extinguish the flame on their tails to prevent fires.

name: Silcoon
pokedex: It prepares for evolution using the energy it stored while it was a Wurmple. It keeps watch over the surroundings with its two eyes.

name: Raboot
pokedex: Its thick and fluffy fur protects it from the cold and enables it to use hotter fire moves.

name: Bonsly
pokedex: Bonsly prefers an arid atmosphere. In order to adjust the level of fluids in its body, it exudes water from its eyes. This makes it appear to be crying.

name: Rowlet
pokedex: This wary Pokémon uses photosynthesis to store up energy during the day, while becoming active at night. Silently it glides, drawing near to its target.

name: Finizen
pokedex: Its water ring is made from seawater mixed with a sticky fluid that Finizen secretes from its blowhole.

name: Whismur
pokedex: Its cries equal a jet plane in volume. It inhales through its ear canals. Because of this system, it can cry continually without having to catch its breath.

name: Exeggcute
pokedex: It consists of six eggs that care for each other. The eggs attract each other and spin around. When cracks increasingly appear, it is close to evolution.

name: Feebas
pokedex: Feebas live in ponds that are heavily infested with weeds. Because of its hopelessly shabby appearance, it seems as if few Trainers raise it.

name: Scatterbug
pokedex: When under attack from bird Pokémon, it spews a poisonous black powder that causes paralysis on contact. Scatterbug can live in any region or climate.

name: Tarountula
pokedex: The thread it secretes from its rear is as strong as wire. The secret behind the thread's strength is the topic of ongoing research.

name: Darumaka
pokedex: When its internal fire is burning, it cannot calm down and it runs around. When the fire diminishes, it pulls its limbs into its body and falls asleep.

name: Chingling
pokedex: There is an orb inside its mouth. When it hops, the orb bounces all over and makes a ringing sound. It can cry for an awfully long time.

name: Joltik
pokedex: Since they can't generate their own electricity, they attach themselves to large-bodied Pokémon and absorb static electricity, which they store in a pouch.

name: Wimpod
pokedex: This Pokémon is a coward. As it desperately dashes off, the flailing of its many legs leaves a sparkling clean path in its wake. It lives on beaches and seabeds.

name: Audino
pokedex: Its auditory sense is astounding. Using the feelers on its ears, it can tell how someone is feeling or when an egg might hatch.

name: Diggersby
pokedex: With its powerful ears it reduces dense bedrock to rubble. It can be a big help at construction sites. When it's finished digging, it lounges about lazily.

name: Swadloon
pokedex: Forests where Swadloon live have superb foliage because the nutrients they make from fallen leaves nourish the plant life.

name: Miltank
pokedex: It gives over five gallons of milk daily. Its sweet milk is enjoyed by children and grown-ups alike. People who can't drink milk turn it into yogurt and eat it instead.

name: Abra
pokedex: A Pokémon that sleeps 18 hours a day. Observation revealed that it uses Teleport to change its location once every hour.

name: Solosis
pokedex: Because their bodies are enveloped in a special liquid, they are fine in any environment, no matter how severe. They can use telepathy to talk with others.

name: Zubat
pokedex: While living in pitch-black caverns, their eyes gradually grew shut and deprived them of vision. They use ultrasonic waves to detect obstacles.

name: Tympole
pokedex: By vibrating its cheeks, it emits sound waves imperceptible to humans. It uses the rhythm of these sounds to talk and warns others of danger.

name: Dottler
pokedex: It barely moves, but it's still alive. Hiding in its shell without food or water seems to have awakened its psychic powers.

name: Plusle
pokedex: It has the trait of cheering on its fellow Pokémon. By shorting out the electricity it releases from its paws, it creates pom-poms for cheering.

name: Minun
pokedex: At a meeting of Pokémon academics, it was announced that simultaneous exposure to electricity from a Plusle and Minun will promote circulation and boost vitality.

name: Lillipup
pokedex: It faces strong opponents with great courage. Because it doesn't yelp, it's extremely popular with Trainers who live in apartment buildings.

name: Zigzagoon
pokedex: Its restlessness has it constantly moving in zigzags. It will purposely run into other Pokémon to start fights. It's thought to be the oldest form of Zigzagoon.

name: Nacli
pokedex: The ground scrapes its body as it travels, causing it to leave salt behind. Salt is constantly being created and replenished inside Nacli's body.

name: Drampa
pokedex: This Pokémon is friendly to people and loves children most of all. It comes from deep in the mountains to play with children it likes in town.

name: Karrablast
pokedex: When they feel threatened, they spit an acidic liquid to drive attackers away. For some reason they evolve while they are in the same place as Shelmet.

name: Blitzle
pokedex: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use the frequency and rhythm of these flashes to communicate with one another.

name: Tynamo
pokedex: These Pokémon move in schools. One alone can emit only a trickle of electricity, so a group of them gathers to unleash a powerful electric shock.

name: Unown
pokedex: This Pokémon is shaped like ancient text characters. Although research is ongoing, it is a mystery as to which came first, the ancient writings or the various Unown.

name: Vulpix
pokedex: It can freely control fire, making fiery orbs fly like will-o'-the-wisps. Just before evolution, its six tails grow hot  as if on fire.

name: Vulpix
pokedex: They live together in a skulk, helping one another. In hot weather, this Pokémon makes ice shards with its six tails and sprays them around to cool itself off.

name: Shellos
pokedex: It oozes a purple fluid to deter enemies. While harmless, the fluid is awfully sticky. Apparently, there are more West Sea Shellos now than there were in the past.

name: Nickit
pokedex: Aided by the soft pads on its feet, it silently raids the food stores of other Pokémon. It survives off its ill-gotten gains.

name: Rolycoly
pokedex: Most of its body has the same composition as coal. Fittingly, this Pokémon was first discovered in coal mines about 400 years ago.

name: Sizzlipede
pokedex: It stores flammable gas in its body and uses it to generate heat. The yellow sections on its belly get particularly hot.

name: Burmy
pokedex: If its cloak is even slightly damaged, it will immediately repair it with whatever is near at hand. The Pokémon within the cloak is scrawny and vulnerable to the cold.

name: Cacnea
pokedex: Cacnea live in deserts with virtually no rainfall. It battles by swinging its thick, spiked arms. Once a year, a yellow flower blooms.

name: Skiddo
pokedex: If it has sunshine and water, it doesn't need to eat, because it can generate energy from the leaves on its back. It has a placid disposition.

name: Hoppip
pokedex: This Pokémon drifts and floats with the wind. If it senses the approach of strong winds, a Hoppip links leaves with others to prepare against being blown away.

name: Psyduck
pokedex: When its headache intensifies, it starts using strange powers. However, it has no recollection of its powers, so it always looks befuddled and bewildered.

name: Whimsicott
pokedex: It rides on the wind and slips into people's homes. After it has turned a room into a cotton-filled mess, it giggles to itself and takes off.

name: Baltoy
pokedex: A Baltoy moves by spinning on its single foot. It has been depicted in murals  adorning the walls of a once-bustling city in an ancient age.

name: Froakie
pokedex: It protects its skin by covering its body in bubbles it secretes from its chest and back. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air, it keeps a watchful eye on its surroundings.

name: Chespin
pokedex: The quills on its head are usually soft. When it flexes them, the points become so hard and sharp that they can pierce rock without any effort.

name: Toedscool
pokedex: Though it looks like Tentacool, Toedscool is a completely different species. Its legs may be thin, but it can run at a speed of 30 mph.

name: Trumbeak
pokedex: By bending its beak, it can produce a variety of calls and brand itself a noisy nuisance for its neighbors. It eats berries and stores their seeds in its beak.

name: Bibarel
pokedex: It makes its nest by damming streams with bark and mud. A river dammed by Bibarel will never overflow its banks, which is appreciated by people nearby.

name: Mime Jr.
line: Mime Jr. > Mr. Mime/Mr. Mime > Mr. Rime
pokedex: In an attempt to confuse its enemy, it mimics the enemy's movements. Once mimicked, the foe cannot take its eyes off this Pokémon.

name: Herdier
pokedex: Its dense black fur grows continuously. The high cost of keeping its hard fur properly groomed makes this a troublesome Pokémon to train.

name: Cubone
pokedex: It pines for the mother it will never see again. Seeing a likeness of its mother in the full moon, it cries. The stains on the skull it wears are from its tears.

name: Dedenne
pokedex: Its whiskers serve as antennas. By sending and receiving electrical waves, it can communicate with others over vast distances.

name: Sandshrew
pokedex: Life on mountains covered with deep snow has granted this Pokémon a body of ice that's as hard as steel. Predators go after its soft belly.

name: Lopunny
pokedex: An extremely cautious Pokémon. It is very conscious of its looks and never fails to groom its ears. It runs with sprightly jumps.

name: Oddish
pokedex: This Pokémon grows by absorbing moonlight. During the daytime, it buries itself in the ground, leaving only its leaves exposed to avoid detection by its enemies.

name: Swirlix
